- [Custom layouts](/en/docs/guides/custom-layout)
- [Runtime contracts](/en/docs/api/extensions#extension-runtime)

# Custom nodes and explicit edge IDs (/en/docs/examples/custom-node-extension)





Register a custom node and use explicit edge IDs with combo state.

## Try it

Click an edge or combo to inspect its explicit ID and state.

## Data

A custom node, explicit edge IDs, and a combo share one graph.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Custom node extension demo.
 * Demonstrates: function-style node registration, explicit edge IDs, and shared element state methods for Combos.
 */

import { Graph, register, type NodeExtension } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const statusBadgeNode: NodeExtension = {
  base: 'rect',
  style: {
    size: 42,
    width: 96,
    height: 34,
    borderRadius: 8,
    strokeWidth: 2,
    label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
    labelPlacement: 'center' as const,
    labelFontSize: 11,
    labelColor: '#fff',
    iconType: 'text' as const,
    icon: (node) => String(node.data?.icon ?? ''),
    iconFontSize: 13,
    iconColor: '#fff',
    iconOffsetX: -32,
  },

  getStyle(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
    const role = node.data?.role;
    if (role === 'entry') return { fill: '#2E8B57', stroke: '#1F6B43' };
    if (role === 'compute') return { fill: '#D8911B', stroke: '#A86E12' };
    if (role === 'storage') return { fill: '#4E6E8E', stroke: '#35506B' };
    return { fill: '#64748b', stroke: '#475569' };
  },
};

register('node', 'status-badge-node', statusBadgeNode);

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'gateway', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Gateway', role: 'entry', icon: 'G' }, states: ['selected'] },
        { id: 'worker-a', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Worker A', role: 'compute', icon: 'A' } },
        { id: 'worker-b', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Worker B', role: 'compute', icon: 'B' } },
        { id: 'store', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Store', role: 'storage', icon: 'S' } },
        { id: 'index', comboId: 'demo-combo', data: { label: 'Index', role: 'storage', icon: 'I' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'edge-gateway-worker-a', source: 'gateway', target: 'worker-a' },
        { id: 'edge-gateway-worker-b', source: 'gateway', target: 'worker-b' },
        { id: 'edge-worker-a-store', source: 'worker-a', target: 'store' },
        { id: 'edge-worker-b-index', source: 'worker-b', target: 'index' },
      ],
      combos: [
        { id: 'demo-combo', data: { name: 'Demo Combo' } },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'status-badge-node',
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#003eb3', strokeWidth: 3, haloWidth: 16 },
        active: { stroke: '#1677ff', strokeWidth: 3 },
        highlight: { stroke: '#1677ff', strokeWidth: 3 },
      },
    },
    edge: {
      style: {
        stroke: '#9ca3af',
        lineWidth: 2,
        endArrow: true,
        label: (_s, _t, edge) => edge.id ?? '',
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.86)',
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#1677ff', lineWidth: 3 },
      },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        padding: 42,
        borderRadius: 10,
        fill: 'rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.06)',
        stroke: 'rgba(22, 119, 255, 0.28)',
        label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.name ?? combo.id),
        labelFontSize: 13,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 45, ranksep: 90, nodeSize: [96, 34] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node', 'click-select', 'hover-highlight'],
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.setItemState('demo-combo', 'selected', true);

  const containerEl =
    typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;

  const ui = createDemoPanel(containerEl, 'demo-combo states: selected');
  ui.addAction('切换 Combo 状态', () => {
    const selected = graph.getItemStates('demo-combo').includes('selected');
    graph.setItemState('demo-combo', 'selected', !selected);
    ui.setStatus(`demo-combo states: ${graph.getItemStates('demo-combo').join(', ') || '(none)'}`);
  });
  ui.addAction('选中显式边 ID', () => {
    graph.setItemState('edge-worker-a-store', 'selected', true);
    ui.setStatus('selected edgeId: edge-worker-a-store');
  });

  graph.on('edge:click', (payload: { edgeId?: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`edge:click edgeId=${payload.edgeId}`);
  });
  graph.on('combo:click', (payload: { comboId: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`combo:click comboId=${payload.comboId}`);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

- [Custom nodes](/en/docs/guides/custom-node)
- [Drawing contracts](/en/docs/api/extensions#extension-drawing)

# Node and edge mutations (/en/docs/examples/data-mutations)





Demonstrate individual and batch node and edge additions, updates, and removals.

## Try it

Choose addNode then addEdge: counts change from 3/2 to 4/3. removeNode also removes its adjacent edge; reset restores initial data.

## Data

Apply incremental updates to a small business relationship dataset.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const INITIAL_DATA: GraphData = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A', color: '#5B8FF9' } },
    { id: 'b', x: 300, y: 90, data: { label: 'B', color: '#5AD8A6' } },
    { id: 'c', x: 300, y: 230, data: { label: 'C', color: '#F6BD16' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e-a-b', source: 'a', target: 'b', data: { weight: 1 } },
    { id: 'e-a-c', source: 'a', target: 'c', data: { weight: 2 } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: INITIAL_DATA,
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        size: 34,
        fill: (node) => String(node.data?.color ?? '#5B8FF9'),
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#94a3b8',
        lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.weight ?? 1) + 1,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  let lastEvent = 'ready';
  let sequence = 0;
  const renderStatus = () => {
    const snapshot = graph.getData();
    ui.setStatus(
      `nodes=${graph.getNodeCount()} edges=${graph.getEdgeCount()}\n` +
        `ids=${snapshot.nodes.map((node) => node.id).join(', ')}\n` +
        `last=${lastEvent}`,
    );
  };

  for (const event of ['afteradditem', 'afterupdateitem', 'afterremoveitem'] as const) {
    graph.on(event, (payload: { type: string; id: string; action?: string }) => {
      lastEvent = `${event}: ${payload.type}:${payload.id}${payload.action ? ` (${payload.action})` : ''}`;
      renderStatus();
    });
  }

  ui.addAction('addNode', () => {
    if (!graph.hasNode('d')) graph.addNode({ id: 'd', x: 480, y: 160, data: { label: 'D', color: '#E8684A' } });
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('addEdge', () => {
    if (graph.hasNode('d') && !graph.hasEdge('e-c-d')) {
      graph.addEdge({ id: 'e-c-d', source: 'c', target: 'd', data: { weight: 3 } });
    }
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('updateNodeData', () => {
    sequence++;
    graph.updateNodeData('b', {
      label: `B${sequence}`,
      color: sequence % 2 ? '#9270CA' : '#5AD8A6',
    });
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('updateEdgeData', () => {
    graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: 'e-a-c', data: { weight: (sequence % 4) + 1 } }]);
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('批量新增', () => {
    if (!graph.hasNode('e')) {
      graph.addNodes([
        { id: 'e', x: 480, y: 70, data: { label: 'E', color: '#6DC8EC' } },
        { id: 'f', x: 480, y: 250, data: { label: 'F', color: '#FF9D4D' } },
      ]);
      graph.addEdges([
        { id: 'e-b-e', source: 'b', target: 'e', data: { weight: 1 } },
        { id: 'e-c-f', source: 'c', target: 'f', data: { weight: 1 } },
      ]);
    }
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('removeEdge', () => {
    const edgeId = graph.hasEdge('e-c-d') ? 'e-c-d' : graph.hasEdge('e-a-c') ? 'e-a-c' : '';
    if (edgeId) graph.removeEdge(edgeId);
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('removeNode', () => {
    const nodeId = graph.hasNode('d') ? 'd' : graph.hasNode('f') ? 'f' : '';
    if (nodeId) graph.removeNode(nodeId);
    renderStatus();
  });
  ui.addAction('重置', async () => {
    await graph.setData(INITIAL_DATA, { fitView: { padding: 80 } });
    lastEvent = 'datachange: reset';
    renderStatus();
  });

  renderStatus();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Mutation methods](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-data-mutations)
- [Query models](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-data)
- [Data ingestion and updates](/en/docs/guides/data)

# Node badges (/en/docs/examples/decoration-badges)





Stack count, status, and text badges on a node boundary.

## Try it

Orders has 5 badges, initially two plus an overflow marker. Hover ··· to expand all 5; leave to collapse. Refresh keeps a single set of badges.

## Data

Three nodes stack built-in badges on their boundary.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: stack built-in badges on a node boundary.
 */
import { Graph, type NodeBadgeItem } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    // Padding covers the boundary badges extending past the rightmost node.
    autoFit: { padding: 56 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 'orders',
          data: {
            label: '订单',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'count', value: 12 },
              { kind: 'warning' },
              { kind: 'text', text: '优先' },
              { kind: 'lock' },
              { kind: 'favorite' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'users',
          data: {
            label: '用户',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'favorite' },
              { kind: 'lock' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        { id: 'audit', data: { label: '审计', badges: [{ kind: 'count', value: 3 }] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[] } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'users', target: 'orders' },
        { source: 'orders', target: 'audit' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: { size: 56, fill: '#5B8FF9', label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' },
      decorations: [
        {
          renderer: 'builtin-badge',
          placement: 'right',
          attachment: 'boundary',
          anchor: 'start',
          boundaryOverlap: 'half-badge',
          layout: 'stack',
          items: (node) => (node.data?.badges as NodeBadgeItem[] | undefined) ?? [],
          maxVisible: 3,
          overflow: 'hover-expand',
          overflowData: { kind: 'text', text: '···' },
        },
      ],
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1' } },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 40, ranksep: 120, nodeSize: 56 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

## Steps and expected results [#steps-and-expected-results]

1. The 订单 (orders) node has 5 badge items. With `maxVisible: 3`, it initially shows a count, a warning, and `···`, with 3 items hidden. The 用户 (users) node shows both items; 审计 (audit) shows its single item.
2. Move the pointer over `···` beside orders to expand all 5 items. Leave the expanded region to fold them again.
3. Change `maxVisible` to `5` in the source and click Run: all badges should appear immediately. Reset restores the original example.

The key options are in `node.decorations[]`: `items` reads each node's business data, `anchor` and `boundaryOverlap` control boundary alignment, and `overflowData` provides the hover target. Badges and node labels are configured separately.

See the [node guide](/en/docs/guides/node) and [decoration usage](/en/docs/guides/extensions#decoration-visibility); consult the [decoration reference](/en/docs/api/options#config-node-decoration) for complete definitions.


## Related documentation

- [Node decorations](/en/docs/guides/custom-decoration)
- [Node reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-node)

# Default themes and interaction states (/en/docs/examples/default-theme)





Inspect the light and dark presets together with built-in node and edge states.

## Try it

Switch node and edge shapes, isolate one preset, and use smooth wheel zoom.

## Data

Six nodes and six edges cover default, active, selected, highlight, inactive, and disabled states.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: default light/dark theme, built-in states, node shapes, and edge shapes.
 */
import {
  Graph,
  type EdgeLabelPlacement,
  type EdgeState,
  type NodeState,
} from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

type NodeType = 'circle' | 'rect';
type EdgeType = 'line' | 'arc' | 'cubic' | 'polyline';
type ThemeName = 'light' | 'dark';

const nodeStates: Array<{ state: NodeState; label: string }> = [
  { state: 'default', label: 'Default' },
  { state: 'active', label: 'Active' },
  { state: 'selected', label: 'Selected' },
  { state: 'highlight', label: 'Highlight' },
  { state: 'inactive', label: 'Inactive' },
  { state: 'disabled', label: 'Disabled' },
];

const edgeStates: EdgeState[] = ['default', 'selected', 'highlight', 'inactive', 'disabled', 'active'];
const edgeLabelPlacements: EdgeLabelPlacement[] = ['end', 'center', 'start'];

const data = {
  nodes: [
    ...nodeStates.map(({ state, label }, index) => ({
      id: `node-${state}`,
      data: { label },
      x: index % 2 === 0 ? 60 : 260,
      y: 48 + Math.floor(index / 2) * 200,
      states: state === 'default' ? undefined : [state],
    })),
    ...edgeStates.flatMap((state, index) => [
      {
        id: `edge-${state}-source`,
        data: { sampleAnchor: true },
        x: 340,
        y: 48 + index * 62,
      },
      {
        id: `edge-${state}-target`,
        data: { sampleAnchor: true },
        x: 520,
        y: 48 + index * 62,
      },
    ]),
  ],
  edges: edgeStates.map((state, index) => ({
    id: `edge-${state}`,
    source: `edge-${state}-source`,
    target: `edge-${state}-target`,
    data: {
      label: state === 'default' ? 'Default edge' : state,
      placement: edgeLabelPlacements[index % edgeLabelPlacements.length],
    },
    states: state === 'default' ? undefined : [state],
  })),
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root =
    typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  root.replaceChildren();
  root.style.cssText =
    'position:relative;display:flex;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;font-family:system-ui;';

  const grid = document.createElement('div');
  grid.style.cssText =
    'flex:1;min-height:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;padding:48px 12px 12px;';
  root.append(grid);

  const graphCards = new Map<ThemeName, { card: HTMLElement; surface: HTMLElement }>();
  for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
    const card = document.createElement('section');
    card.style.cssText =
      'min-width:0;min-height:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #cbd5e1;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(15,23,42,.08);';
    const cardHeader = document.createElement('div');
    cardHeader.style.cssText =
      'height:38px;flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;padding:0 13px;background:#fff;color:#0f172a;font-size:12px;';
    cardHeader.innerHTML = `<strong>${theme === 'light' ? 'Light preset' : 'Dark preset'}</strong><code style="color:#64748b">theme: '${theme}'</code>`;
    const surface = document.createElement('div');
    surface.style.cssText = 'position:relative;flex:1;min-height:0;';
    card.append(cardHeader, surface);
    grid.appendChild(card);
    graphCards.set(theme, { card, surface });
  }

  let graphs: Graph[] = [];
  let nodeType: NodeType = 'circle';
  let edgeType: EdgeType = 'line';

  const renderGraphs = async () => {
    graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
    graphs = [];
    for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
      const surface = graphCards.get(theme)!.surface;
      surface.replaceChildren();
      const graph = new Graph({
        autoFit: true,
        container: surface,
        data,
        node: {
          type: nodeType,
          style: {
            size: 44,
            opacity: (node) => (node.data?.sampleAnchor === true ? 0 : 1),
            label: (node) =>
              node.data?.sampleAnchor === true ? false : String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
            labelPlacement: 'bottom',
            labelColor: theme === 'light' ? '#334155' : '#dbeafe',
          },
        },
        edge: {
          type: edgeType,
          style: {
            curvature: edgeType === 'arc' ? 0.22 : 0,
            curveOffset: edgeType === 'cubic' ? 42 : 0,
            radius: edgeType === 'polyline' ? 10 : 0,
            label: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? edge.id),
            labelPlacement: (_source, _target, edge) =>
              (edge.data?.placement as EdgeLabelPlacement | undefined) ?? 'center',
            labelColor: theme === 'light' ? '#475569' : '#dbeafe',
            labelBackground:
              theme === 'light' ? 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)' : 'rgba(26,26,26,0.9)',
          },
        },
        label: { scaleWithZoom: false, hideOnLowZoom: false },
        behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
        theme,
      });
      await graph.render();
      graph.fitView({ padding: 24 });
      graphs.push(graph);
    }
  };

  const fitGraphs = () => {
    graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView({ padding: 24 }));
  };

  const updateView = (view: string) => {
    for (const theme of ['light', 'dark'] as const) {
      graphCards.get(theme)!.card.style.display =
        view === 'light + dark' || view === theme ? 'flex' : 'none';
    }
    grid.style.gridTemplateColumns = view === 'light + dark' ? '1fr 1fr' : '1fr';
  };

  await renderGraphs();
  updateView('light + dark');
  const ui = createDemoPanel(root);
  ui.addChoice<NodeType>('Node', ['circle', 'rect'], nodeType, (value) => {
    nodeType = value;
    void renderGraphs();
  });
  ui.addChoice<EdgeType>('Edge', ['line', 'arc', 'cubic', 'polyline'], edgeType, (value) => {
    edgeType = value;
    void renderGraphs();
  });
  ui.addChoice('View', ['light + dark', 'light', 'dark'], 'light + dark', updateView);

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView() {
      fitGraphs();
    },
    destroy() {
      ui.destroy();
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      graphs = [];
      root.replaceChildren();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Theme guide](/en/docs/guides/theme)
- [State methods](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-states)

# Call graph (/en/docs/examples/dependency-graph)





Show service calls with a left-to-right hierarchical layout.

## Try it

Hover a service to highlight its neighbors.

## Data

Service nodes are ordered from left to right by call direction.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: a left-to-right service call chain.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const CALLS: Array<[string, string, string]> = [
  ['gateway', '网关', 'auth'],
  ['auth', '鉴权', 'user'],
  ['auth', '鉴权', 'order'],
  ['user', '用户', 'profile'],
  ['order', '订单', 'inventory'],
  ['order', '订单', 'payment'],
  ['inventory', '库存', 'warehouse'],
  ['payment', '支付', 'ledger'],
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const nodes = new Map<string, string>();
  for (const [source, sourceLabel, target] of CALLS) nodes.set(source, sourceLabel);
  nodes.set('profile', '资料');
  nodes.set('warehouse', '仓库');
  nodes.set('ledger', '账本');

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [...nodes].map(([id, label]) => ({ id, data: { label } })),
      edges: CALLS.map(([source, , target]) => ({ source, target })),
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 84,
        height: 34,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1', lineWidth: 1.5 } },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 24, ranksep: 64, nodeSize: [84, 34] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# Drag edge endpoints (/en/docs/examples/drag-edge)





Drag an edge endpoint onto another node to reconnect it.

## Try it

Drag near an endpoint and release it on another node.

## Data

Two edges can be dragged onto another node.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 240, data: { label: 'C' } },
        { id: 'd', x: 560, y: 160, data: { label: 'D' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'editable-edge', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'reference-edge', source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 38, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { lineWidth: 4, hitAreaWidth: 16, endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-edge'],
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  graph.on('edge:dragstart', (payload: { edgeId?: string; dragEnd: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`dragstart ${payload.edgeId ?? '-'} (${payload.dragEnd})`);
  });
  // #region reconnect
  graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
    if (reconnected && edgeId) {
      graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
    }
    ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
  });
  // #endregion reconnect

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Interactions](/en/docs/guides/behaviors)
- [Behavior reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-behaviors)

import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'web', data: { label: 'Web' }, x: 160, y: 150, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'app', data: { label: 'App' }, x: 160, y: 250, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'api', data: { label: 'API' }, x: 380, y: 200 },
        { id: 'db', data: { label: 'DB' }, x: 560, y: 140 },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: 'Cache' }, x: 560, y: 270 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'app', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'db' },

# Edge arrow directions (/en/docs/examples/edge-arrows)





Compare no-arrow, one-way, bidirectional, and wide-arrow edges.

## Try it

Compare edge direction and width encodings side by side.

## Data

Four edge groups map different directions and widths.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Arrow directions - none / forward / bidirectional
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function runGraph(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'n1', name: 'No arrow', x: 80, y: 120 },
        { id: 't1', name: '', x: 280, y: 120 },
        { id: 'n2', name: 'Forward', x: 400, y: 120 },
        { id: 't2', name: '', x: 600, y: 120 },
        { id: 'n3', name: 'Bidirectional', x: 80, y: 280 },
        { id: 't3', name: '', x: 280, y: 280 },
        { id: 'n4', name: 'Thick + arrow', x: 400, y: 280 },
        { id: 't4', name: '', x: 600, y: 280 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'n1', target: 't1', data: { dir: 'none' } },
        { source: 'n2', target: 't2', data: { dir: 'forward' } },
        { source: 'n3', target: 't3', data: { dir: 'both' } },
        { source: 'n4', target: 't4', data: { dir: 'forward', lw: 6 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 24, label: (node) => node.name ?? '' } },
    // #region arrow-options
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#99ADD1',
        lineWidth: (_source, _target, edge) => Number(edge.data?.lw ?? 2),
        endArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir !== 'none',
        startArrow: (_source, _target, edge) => edge.data?.dir === 'both',
      },
    },
    // #endregion arrow-options
    theme: 'light',
  });

  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = await runGraph(container);
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```

# Edge colors (/en/docs/examples/edge-colors)





Map edge colors from a business category.

## Try it

Edge color comes from a category field.

## Data

Edge color comes from a category index on the edge.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Edge colors - category palette
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const PALETTE = ['#1783FF', '#00C9C9', '#F08F56', '#D580FF', '#7863FF', '#DB9D0D', '#60C42D', '#FF80CA', '#2491B3', '#17C76F'];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const nodes: { id: string; name: string; x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  const edges: { source: string; target: string; data: { idx: number } }[] = [];

  for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
    const x = 60 + i * 100;
    nodes.push({ id: `s${i}`, name: PALETTE[i].slice(1, 4), x, y: 60 });
    nodes.push({ id: `t${i}`, name: '', x, y: 200 });
    edges.push({ source: `s${i}`, target: `t${i}`, data: { idx: i } });
  }

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 20 } },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: (_s: any, _t: any, e: any) => PALETTE[e.data?.idx % PALETTE.length],
        lineWidth: 3,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```

# Hit area (/en/docs/examples/edge-hit-area)





Keep a thin stroke while expanding the pick area of lines, curves, and loops.

## Try it

Move the pointer near a thin edge and see that the hit area is wider than the stroke.

## Data

The visible stroke stays thin while the hit width is larger.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const EDGE_TYPES = [
  { type: 'line' as const, title: '直线 + 箭头' },
  { type: 'arc' as const, title: '弧线 / 平行边' },
  { type: 'cubic' as const, title: '三次曲线' },
  { type: 'polyline' as const, title: '折线' },
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root =
    typeof container === 'string' ? (document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement) : container;
  const graphs: Graph[] = [];
  const board = document.createElement('div');
  board.style.cssText =
    'display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));grid-template-rows:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:8px;width:100%;height:calc(100% - 36px);padding:8px;box-sizing:border-box;';
  root.appendChild(board);

  const ui = createDemoPanel(root, '边保持 1.5px 视觉宽度，但中心线两侧约 8px 都可悬停或点击。缩放后屏幕热区保持不变。');

  for (const [index, item] of EDGE_TYPES.entries()) {
    const panel = document.createElement('div');
    panel.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
    panel.style.cssText = 'position:relative;min-height:0;';
    const title = document.createElement('div');
    title.textContent = item.title;
    title.style.cssText =
      'position:absolute;z-index:2;left:12px;top:10px;font:12px/1.5 system-ui;color:#475569;pointer-events:none;';
    const canvasHost = document.createElement('div');
    canvasHost.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;';
    panel.append(title, canvasHost);
    board.appendChild(panel);

    const sourceId = `source-${index}`;
    const targetId = `target-${index}`;
    const graph = new Graph({
      autoFit: true,
      container: canvasHost,
      data: {
        nodes: [
          { id: sourceId, x: 100, y: 120 },
          { id: targetId, x: 340, y: index === 2 || index === 3 ? 150 : 120 },
        ],
        edges: [
          { id: `edge-${index}`, source: sourceId, target: targetId },
          ...(item.type === 'line'
            ? [{ id: `loop-${index}`, source: sourceId, target: sourceId }]
            : []),
        ],
      },
      node: {
        type: 'circle',
        style: { size: 26, fill: '#1677ff', stroke: '#fff', strokeWidth: 2 },
      },
      edge: {
        type: item.type,
        style: {
          stroke: '#64748b',
          lineWidth: 1.5,
          hitAreaWidth: 16,
          endArrow: true,
          curvature: 0.35,
          curveOffset: 80,
          router: 'orth',
        },
        stateStyles: {
          highlight: { stroke: '#1677ff', lineWidth: 2 },
          selected: { stroke: '#873bf4', lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 20 },
        },
      },
      behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'highlight-edge', 'click-select'],
      theme: 'light',
    });
    graph.on('edge:pointerover', ({ edgeId }) => ui.setStatus(`hover: ${edgeId ?? '-'}`));
    graph.on('edge:pointerleave', () => ui.setStatus('move near a thin edge'));
    graph.on('edge:selectchange', ({ edgeId, selected }) =>
      ui.setStatus(`${selected ? 'selected' : 'unselected'}: ${edgeId ?? '-'}`),
    );
    await graph.render();
    graphs.push(graph);
  }

  ui.setStatus('move near a thin edge');
  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView: () => graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView()),
    destroy: () => {
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      board.remove();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Edge configuration](/en/docs/guides/edge)
- [Edge reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-edge)

# Edge states and weight (/en/docs/examples/edge-states)





Map edge width from weight and inspect edge state styles.

## Try it

Line width follows the weight field.

## Data

Edge width is derived from a weight field.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: edge weight x state matrix
 *
 * 7 rows (default/level 1-6) x 6 columns (Default/Active/Selected/Disabled/Highlight/Inactive)
 * Aligned with design spec 2.1 + 2.2
 */
import { Graph, type EdgeState } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const states: EdgeState[] = ['default', 'active', 'selected', 'disabled', 'highlight', 'inactive'];
  const lineWidths = [1, 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12];

  const startX = 80;
  const gapX = 200;
  const startY = 80;
  const gapY = 80;
  const edgeLen = 120;

  const nodes: { id: string; name: string; x: number; y: number }[] = [];
  const edges: { source: string; target: string; states?: EdgeState[]; data?: Record<string, unknown> }[] = [];

  for (let row = 0; row < lineWidths.length; row++) {
    for (let col = 0; col < states.length; col++) {
      const state = states[col];
      const srcId = `r${row}-c${col}-src`;
      const tgtId = `r${row}-c${col}-tgt`;
      const x = startX + col * gapX;
      const y = startY + row * gapY;

      nodes.push({ id: srcId, name: [row === 0 ? state : '', col === 0 ? `${lineWidths[row]}px` : ''].filter(Boolean).join(' / '), x, y });
      nodes.push({ id: tgtId, name: '', x: x + edgeLen, y });

      edges.push({
        source: srcId,
        target: tgtId,
        states: state === 'default' ? undefined : [state],
        data: { weight: row },
      });
    }
  }

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        size: 24,
        label: (node) => node.name ?? '',
        labelPlacement: 'top',
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#99ADD1',
        endArrow: true,
        lineWidth: (_src, _tgt, e) => {
          const w = (e.data as Record<string, number>)?.weight ?? 0;
          return lineWidths[w];
        },
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Edge configuration](/en/docs/guides/edge)
- [Edge reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-edge)

# Edge types (/en/docs/examples/edge-types)





Compare solid lines, dashed lines and two arc curvatures.

## Try it

Compare solid and dashed lines above, then curvature 0.3 and 0.6 below. Fit or refresh retains both comparisons.

## Data

Two views each have 4 nodes and 2 edges. Both lower edges use arc, not cubic.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Edge types - solid / dashed / arc
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graphs: Graph[] = [];
  const root = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;

  // Line edges: solid + dashed
  const lineDiv = document.createElement('div');
  lineDiv.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  lineDiv.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;';
  root.appendChild(lineDiv);

  const g1 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: lineDiv,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 's1', name: 'Solid', x: 80, y: 80 },
        { id: 't1', name: '', x: 280, y: 80 },
        { id: 's2', name: 'Dashed', x: 400, y: 80 },
        { id: 't2', name: '', x: 600, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 's1', target: 't1', data: { dash: false } },
        { source: 's2', target: 't2', data: { dash: true } },
      ],
    },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 24 } },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#99ADD1',
        lineWidth: 2,
        endArrow: true,
        lineDash: (_s: any, _t: any, e: any) => e.data?.dash ? [6, 4] : [],
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g1.render();
  graphs.push(g1);

  // Arc edges
  const arcDiv = document.createElement('div');
  arcDiv.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  arcDiv.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;margin-top:16px;';
  root.appendChild(arcDiv);

  const g2 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: arcDiv,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a1', name: 'Arc', x: 80, y: 80 },
        { id: 'a2', name: '', x: 280, y: 80 },
        { id: 'a3', name: 'Arc wide', x: 400, y: 80 },
        { id: 'a4', name: '', x: 600, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a1', target: 'a2', data: { c: 0.3 } },
        { source: 'a3', target: 'a4', data: { c: 0.6 } },
      ],
    },
    node: { type: 'circle', style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 24 } },
    edge: {
      type: 'arc',
      style: {
        stroke: '#5B8FF9',
        lineWidth: 2,
        curvature: (_s: any, _t: any, e: any) => e.data?.c ?? 0.3,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g2.render();
  graphs.push(g2);

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView: () => graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView()),
    destroy: () => {
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      lineDiv.remove(); arcDiv.remove();
    },
  };
}
```

# Event log (/en/docs/examples/event-log)





Inspect the public events emitted by click, drag, and selection.

## Try it

Click or drag a node and read the latest events.

## Data

Four nodes enable click selection and dragging together.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: listen to click, drag, and selection events.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', data: { label: 'A' }, x: 140, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', data: { label: 'B' }, x: 320, y: 100 },
        { id: 'c', data: { label: 'C' }, x: 320, y: 260 },
        { id: 'd', data: { label: 'D' }, x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 36,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'click-select', 'drag-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container, '点击或拖拽节点，查看最近的公开事件。');
  const lines: string[] = ['点击或拖拽节点'];
  const push = (line: string) => {
    lines.unshift(line);
    ui.setStatus(lines.slice(0, 4).join('\n'));
  };
  graph.on('node:click', ({ nodeId }) => push(`node:click ${nodeId}`));
  graph.on('node:dragend', ({ nodeId }) => push(`node:dragend ${nodeId}`));
  graph.on('node:selectchange', ({ nodeId, selected }) => push(`node:selectchange ${nodeId} ${selected}`));
  ui.setStatus(lines[0]);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

Click a node for node:selectchange, or drag it for node:dragend. A completed drag suppresses its subsequent node click. See the [event guide](/en/docs/guides/events) for integration and the [event reference](/en/docs/api/graph/events) for payloads and timing.


## Related documentation

- [Event guide](/en/docs/guides/events)
- [Event reference](/en/docs/api/graph/events)

# Extension system showcase (/en/docs/examples/extension-system)





Combine decoration, edge, layout, transform, behavior, and plugin extensions.

## Try it

Click a node to change its size, and hover ··· to expand hidden badges.

## Data

A small graph demonstrates six categories of public extension points.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: public extension APIs working together without internal imports.
 */
import {
  Graph,
  register,
  type BehaviorExtension,
  type BehaviorOptions,
  type DecorationRenderer,
  type ElementState,
  type ExtensionContext,
  type GraphData,
  type GraphNode,
  type LayoutExtension,
  type NodeBadgeItem,
  type PluginExtension,
  type PluginOptions,
  type TransformExtension,
} from '@antv/g6-lite';

const externalNameRenderer: DecorationRenderer<string> = {
  measure({ ctx, data, dpr, labelScale = dpr }) {
    ctx.font = `bold ${11 * labelScale}px sans-serif`;
    return { width: ctx.measureText(data).width, height: 14 * labelScale };
  },
  draw({ ctx, data, dpr, labelScale = dpr }) {
    ctx.font = `bold ${11 * labelScale}px sans-serif`;
    ctx.textAlign = 'center';
    ctx.textBaseline = 'middle';
    ctx.fillStyle = '#1f1f1f';
    ctx.fillText(data, 0, 0);
  },
};

const horizontalLayout: LayoutExtension = {
  execute(data) {
    return {
      nodes: data.nodes.map((node, index) => ({ ...node, x: 120 + index * 180, y: 180 })),
    };
  },
};

const normalizeData: TransformExtension = {
  beforeRender(data: GraphData) {
    return {
      ...data,
      nodes: data.nodes.map((node) => ({
        ...node,
        data: { score: 0, ...node.data },
      })),
    };
  },
};

const BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR = 'business-click' as const;

interface BusinessClickBehaviorOptions extends BehaviorOptions<typeof BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR> {
  state?: ElementState;
  compactSize?: number;
  expandedSize?: number;
}

function createBusinessClickBehavior(): BehaviorExtension<BusinessClickBehaviorOptions> {
  let context: ExtensionContext | undefined;
  let state: ElementState = 'selected';
  let compactSize = 32;
  let expandedSize = 68;

  return {
    init(nextContext, options) {
      context = nextContext;
      state = options.state ?? 'selected';
      compactSize = options.compactSize ?? 32;
      expandedSize = options.expandedSize ?? 68;
    },
    getEvents() {
      return {
        'node:click': ({ nodeId }) => {
          if (!context) return;
          context.state.set(nodeId, [state]);
          const node = context.data.getNode(nodeId);
          const currentSize = Number(node?.data?.size ?? 44);
          context.data.updateNode(nodeId, {
            size: currentSize >= expandedSize ? compactSize : expandedSize,
          });
        },
        'canvas:click': () => {
          if (!context) return;
          const stateMap = Object.fromEntries(context.data.getNodeIds().map((id) => [id, []]));
          context.state.setAll(stateMap);
        },
      };
    },
    destroy() {
      context = undefined;
    },
  };
}

const EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN = 'extension-hint' as const;

interface ExtensionHintPluginOptions extends PluginOptions<typeof EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN> {
  text?: string;
}

function createExtensionHintPlugin(): PluginExtension<ExtensionHintPluginOptions> {
  let hint: HTMLElement | undefined;
  let text = '点击节点切换 32px / 68px · 悬停 ··· 展开徽章';

  return {
    init(_context, options) {
      text = options.text ?? text;
    },
    mount(container) {
      hint = document.createElement('div');
      hint.className = 'g6lite-extension-demo-hint';
      hint.textContent = text;
      Object.assign(hint.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        left: '12px',
        top: '12px',
        zIndex: '20',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 24px)',
        color: '#64748b',
        font: '12px/1.4 system-ui, sans-serif',
        pointerEvents: 'none',
      });
      container.appendChild(hint);
    },
    destroy() {
      hint?.remove();
      hint = undefined;
    },
  };
}

register('decoration', 'external-name', externalNameRenderer);
register('edge', 'business-relation', {
  base: 'arc',
  style: { stroke: '#91caff', lineWidth: 2, curvature: 0.18, endArrow: true },
  stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#1677ff', lineWidth: 3 } },
});
register('layout', 'horizontal-business', () => ({ ...horizontalLayout }));
register('transform', 'normalize-business-data', () => ({ ...normalizeData }));
register('behavior', BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR, () => createBusinessClickBehavior());
register('plugin', EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN, () => createExtensionHintPlugin());

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // Padding keeps the boundary badges (star, count pill) off the canvas edge.
  const viewPadding = 40;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: viewPadding },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        {
          id: 'customer',
          data: {
            label: '客户',
            size: 44,
            namePlacement: 'bottom',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'text', text: '待问题排查' },
              { kind: 'count', value: 12 },
              { kind: 'warning' },
              { kind: 'favorite' },
              { kind: 'lock' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'order',
          data: {
            label: '订单',
            size: 44,
            namePlacement: 'right',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'lock' },
              { kind: 'text', text: '待排查' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
        {
          id: 'product',
          data: {
            label: '商品',
            size: 44,
            namePlacement: 'left',
            badges: [
              { kind: 'favorite' },
              { kind: 'icon', icon: '★' },
            ] satisfies NodeBadgeItem[],
          },
        },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'customer-order', source: 'customer', target: 'order' },
        { id: 'order-product', source: 'order', target: 'product' },
      ],
    },
    transforms: ['normalize-business-data'],
    layout: { type: 'horizontal-business' },
    behaviors: [
      'drag-canvas',
      'zoom-canvas',
      {
        type: BUSINESS_CLICK_BEHAVIOR,
        state: 'selected',
        compactSize: 32,
        expandedSize: 68,
      } satisfies BusinessClickBehaviorOptions,
    ],
    plugins: [
      {
        type: EXTENSION_HINT_PLUGIN,
        text: '点击节点切换 32px / 68px · 悬停 ··· 展开徽章',
      } satisfies ExtensionHintPluginOptions,
    ],
    node: {
      style: {
        size: (node) => Number(node.data?.size ?? 44),
        fill: '#e6f4ff',
        stroke: '#1677ff',
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#bae0ff', strokeWidth: 3 } },
      decorations: [
        {
          renderer: 'external-name',
          placement: (node: GraphNode) =>
            (node.data?.namePlacement as 'left' | 'right' | 'bottom' | undefined) ?? 'bottom',
          attachment: 'outside',
          data: (node: GraphNode) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        },
        {
          renderer: 'builtin-badge',
          placement: (node) => (node.data?.namePlacement === 'left' ? 'left' : 'right'),
          attachment: 'boundary',
          anchor: 'start',
          boundaryOverlap: 'half-badge',
          crossOffsetRatio: 0,
          layout: 'stack',
          sort: 'width-desc',
          maxVisible: 3,
          overflow: 'hover-expand',
          itemGap: 2,
          overflowData: { kind: 'text', text: '···' },
          items: (node) => (node.data?.badges as NodeBadgeItem[] | undefined) ?? [],
        },
      ],
    },
    edge: { type: 'business-relation' },
  });
  await graph.render();
  // The business-click behavior toggles node sizes between 32 and 68; refit
  // after each toggle so resized nodes and their badges stay inside the view.
  graph.on('node:click', () => {
    graph.fitView({ padding: viewPadding });
  });
  return graph;
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Extension selection](/en/docs/guides/extensions)
- [Runtime contracts](/en/docs/api/extensions#extension-runtime)

# Fishbone diagram (/en/docs/examples/fishbone)





Organize a problem, categories, and contributing causes into a fishbone structure.

## Try it

Zoom or pan to read contributing causes and fit the complete diagram.

## Data

Illustrative profit shortfall analysis across 6 categories, with 20 nodes and 19 edges.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 鱼骨图 (Fishbone/Ishikawa Diagram) — 盈利未达预期分析
 */
import { Graph, register, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import fishbone from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/fishbone';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const CATEGORY_COLORS = ['#E8684A', '#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#6F5EF9', '#5D7092'];

const NODE_LEVELS = {
  HEAD: 'head',
  CATEGORY: 'category',
  ITEM: 'item',
};

function createFishboneData() {
  const nodes = [
    { id: 'head', name: '盈利未达预期', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.HEAD } },
    { id: 'cat0', name: '人员', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat1', name: '设备', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 1 } },
    { id: 'cat2', name: '方法', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat3', name: '材料', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 3 } },
    { id: 'cat4', name: '环境', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 4 } },
    { id: 'cat5', name: '测量', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY, categoryIndex: 5 } },
    { id: 'cat0-item0', name: '培训不足', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat0-item1', name: '经验欠缺', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat0-item2', name: '人员流动', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 0 } },
    { id: 'cat1-item0', name: '设备老化', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 1 } },
    { id: 'cat1-item1', name: '维护不当', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 1 } },
    { id: 'cat2-item0', name: '流程不合理', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat2-item1', name: '标准缺失', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat2-item2', name: '执行不到位', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 2 } },
    { id: 'cat3-item0', name: '供应商问题', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 3 } },
    { id: 'cat3-item1', name: '质检不严', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 3 } },
    { id: 'cat4-item0', name: '市场竞争', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 4 } },
    { id: 'cat4-item1', name: '政策变化', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 4 } },
    { id: 'cat5-item0', name: '数据不准', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ITEM, categoryIndex: 5 } },
  ];

  const edges = [
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat0' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat1' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat2' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat3' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat4' },
    { source: 'head', target: 'cat5' },
    { source: 'cat0', target: 'cat0-item0' },
    { source: 'cat0', target: 'cat0-item1' },
    { source: 'cat0', target: 'cat0-item2' },
    { source: 'cat1', target: 'cat1-item0' },
    { source: 'cat1', target: 'cat1-item1' },
    { source: 'cat2', target: 'cat2-item0' },
    { source: 'cat2', target: 'cat2-item1' },
    { source: 'cat2', target: 'cat2-item2' },
    { source: 'cat3', target: 'cat3-item0' },
    { source: 'cat3', target: 'cat3-item1' },
    { source: 'cat4', target: 'cat4-item0' },
    { source: 'cat4', target: 'cat4-item1' },
    { source: 'cat5', target: 'cat5-item0' },
  ];

  return { nodes, edges };
}

const data = createFishboneData();

function getNodeSize(node: { name?: string; data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const name = node.name || '';
  const charWidth = 14;
  const padding = 24;
  const minWidth = 60;
  const calculatedWidth = Math.max(minWidth, name.length * charWidth + padding);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.HEAD) {
    return { width: 160, height: 50 };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY) {
    return { width: 100, height: 36 };
  }
  return { width: calculatedWidth, height: 28 };
}

function getNodeStyle(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const categoryIndex = node.data?.categoryIndex as number | undefined;
  const categoryColor = categoryIndex !== undefined ? CATEGORY_COLORS[categoryIndex % CATEGORY_COLORS.length] : '#5B8FF9';
  const size = getNodeSize(node);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.HEAD) {
    return { fill: '#E8684A', width: size.width, height: size.height, borderRadius: 8, stroke: 'transparent', strokeWidth: 0 };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY) {
    return { fill: categoryColor, width: size.width, height: size.height, borderRadius: 6, stroke: 'transparent', strokeWidth: 0 };
  }
  return { fill: 'transparent', width: size.width, height: size.height, borderRadius: 0, stroke: 'transparent', strokeWidth: 0 };
}

function getNodeLabelColor(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  return level === NODE_LEVELS.ITEM ? '#333' : '#fff';
}

function getEdgeColor(_source: GraphNode, _target: GraphNode, edge: GraphEdge) {
  const targetNode = data.nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.target);
  const categoryIndex = targetNode?.data?.categoryIndex as number | undefined;
  return categoryIndex !== undefined ? CATEGORY_COLORS[categoryIndex % CATEGORY_COLORS.length] : '#d9d9d9';
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'fishbone', fishbone);
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: { type: 'rect', style: (n) => getNodeStyle(n) },
    edge: { type: 'polyline', style: { stroke: getEdgeColor, lineWidth: 1.5, router: 'fishbone', endArrow: false, startArrow: false } },
    layout: { type: 'fishbone', direction: 'LR', categoryGap: 180, itemGap: 44, itemHStep: 50, categoryDistance: 200 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 64 });

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: (n) => (n.data?.level as string) === NODE_LEVELS.ITEM ? 'right-edge' : 'inside',
    nodeSize: (n) => {
      const size = getNodeSize(n);
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      return { width: size.width / dpr, height: size.height / dpr };
    },
    fontSize: (n) => {
      const level = n.data?.level as string;
      return level === NODE_LEVELS.HEAD ? 16 : level === NODE_LEVELS.CATEGORY ? 14 : 12;
    },
    color: (n) => getNodeLabelColor(n),
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => { cleanupLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# Flowchart (/en/docs/examples/flowchart)





Draw a decision flow with a hierarchical layout and polyline edges.

## Try it

Zoom and pan the decision flow.

## Data

Decision nodes use dagre and polyline edges.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 流程图 — 性能诊断决策树 (dagre TB + 矩形节点 + 边标签)
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, attachEdgeLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  start: '#5B8FF9',
  check: '#F6BD16',
  problem: '#E86452',
  action: '#5AD8A6',
};

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'start', name: 'Check I/O wait (top)', data: { role: 'start' } },
    { id: 'mem', name: 'Check swap/free -m', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'cpu', name: 'Check %CPU (top)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'ram_prob', name: 'RAM PROBLEM', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'io', name: 'I/O', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'nw_prob', name: 'NW PROBLEM', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'cpu_prob', name: 'CPU PROBLEM', data: { role: 'problem' } },
    { id: 'ram_hog', name: 'What\'s hogging RAM? (top)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'io_hog', name: 'What\'s hogging I/O? (iotop)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'ext_dep', name: 'Look for an external dependency', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'cpu_confirm', name: 'Confirm by checking CPU %', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'mem_anomaly', name: 'Check history - anomaly?', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'cpu_procs', name: 'Check list of processes (top)', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'kill_mem', name: 'Kill processes (memory)', data: { role: 'action' } },
    { id: 'infra_ram', name: 'Infrastructure - add RAM', data: { role: 'action' } },
    { id: 'cpu_anomaly', name: 'Check history - anomaly?', data: { role: 'check' } },
    { id: 'kill_cpu', name: 'Kill processes (CPU)', data: { role: 'action' } },
    { id: 'infra_cores', name: 'Infrastructure - add cores', data: { role: 'action' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'start', target: 'mem', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'start', target: 'cpu', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'mem', target: 'ram_prob', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'mem', target: 'io', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'cpu', target: 'nw_prob', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'cpu', target: 'cpu_prob', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'ram_prob', target: 'ram_hog' },
    { source: 'io', target: 'io_hog' },
    { source: 'nw_prob', target: 'ext_dep' },
    { source: 'cpu_prob', target: 'cpu_confirm' },
    { source: 'ram_hog', target: 'mem_anomaly' },
    { source: 'cpu_confirm', target: 'cpu_procs' },
    { source: 'mem_anomaly', target: 'kill_mem', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'mem_anomaly', target: 'infra_ram', data: { label: 'false' } },
    { source: 'cpu_procs', target: 'cpu_anomaly' },
    { source: 'cpu_anomaly', target: 'kill_cpu', data: { label: 'true' } },
    { source: 'cpu_anomaly', target: 'infra_cores', data: { label: 'false' } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: (n) => COLORS[n.data?.role as string] ?? '#5B8FF9',
        width: 180,
        height: 32,
        borderRadius: 4,
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 1,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'polyline',
      style: {
        stroke: '#aaa',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        endArrow: true,
        radius: 16,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'TB', nodesep: 40, ranksep: 60, nodeSize: [180, 32] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupNodeLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: 'inside',
    nodeSize: () => ({ width: 180, height: 32 }),
    fontSize: 10,
  });
  const cleanupEdgeLabels = attachEdgeLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    fontSize: 8,
    color: '#555',
    bgColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.95)',
    borderRadius: 6,
    borderColor: '#ddd',
    padding: 3,
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => { cleanupNodeLabels(); cleanupEdgeLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# Hover highlight (/en/docs/examples/hover)





Highlight related elements on hover and dim the rest.

## Try it

Hover a node or edge. Related elements stay clear and the rest dim.

## Data

A hub-and-spoke graph shows the dimmed hover treatment.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Hover 高亮效果（对标 G6 hover-activate 行为）
 *
 * - 悬停节点：高亮该节点及其邻居节点和连接边
 * - 悬停边：高亮该边及其两端节点
 * - 非活跃元素：节点 0.25 透明度、边 0.08 透明度（G6 风格淡化）
 * - 鼠标指针：悬停时变为 pointer
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: '0', name: 'Central' },
        { id: '1', name: 'Node A' },
        { id: '2', name: 'Node B' },
        { id: '3', name: 'Node C' },
        { id: '4', name: 'Node D' },
        { id: '5', name: 'Node E' },
        { id: '6', name: 'Node F' },
        { id: '7', name: 'Node G' },
        { id: '8', name: 'Node H' },
        { id: '9', name: 'Node I' },
        { id: '10', name: 'Node J' },
        { id: '11', name: 'Node K' },
      ],
      edges: [
        // Central hub connections
        { source: '0', target: '1' },
        { source: '0', target: '2' },
        { source: '0', target: '3' },
        { source: '0', target: '4' },
        { source: '0', target: '5' },
        // Cluster A
        { source: '1', target: '6' },
        { source: '1', target: '7' },
        { source: '6', target: '7' },
        // Cluster B
        { source: '2', target: '8' },
        { source: '2', target: '9' },
        { source: '8', target: '9' },
        // Cluster C
        { source: '3', target: '10' },
        { source: '4', target: '10' },
        { source: '4', target: '11' },
        { source: '5', target: '11' },
        // Cross links
        { source: '7', target: '8' },
        { source: '10', target: '11' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => {
          const colors = ['#E86452', '#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#6DC8EC', '#945FB9'];
          const idx = parseInt(d.id);
          if (idx === 0) return '#E86452'; // Central node: red
          if (idx <= 5) return '#5B8FF9';  // First ring: blue
          return '#5AD8A6';                 // Outer ring: green
        },
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#C0C0C0',
        lineWidth: 2,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'force', maxIteration: 300 },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      { type: 'hover-highlight', inactiveState: 'inactive' },
    ],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Interactions](/en/docs/guides/behaviors)
- [Behavior reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-behaviors)

# Indented tree (/en/docs/examples/indented-tree)





Show a directory with the indented layout.

## Try it

Switch between the styled and compact modes.

## Data

Directory nodes are placed with the indented layout.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: 缩进树 — 项目目录结构
 *
 * 展示两种风格：
 * 1. 有背景节点 + 按深度着色（默认）
 * 2. 子节点无样式 — 只有根节点有背景，子节点文字直接显示在边上（设计稿风格）
 *
 * 通过右上角菜单切换两种模式。
 */
import { Graph, register } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import indented from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/indented';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'root', name: 'my-project' },
    { id: 'src', name: 'src' },
    { id: 'comp', name: 'components' },
    { id: 'pages', name: 'pages' },
    { id: 'utils', name: 'utils' },
    { id: 'app', name: 'App.tsx' },
    { id: 'index', name: 'index.tsx' },
    { id: 'public', name: 'public' },
    { id: 'assets', name: 'assets' },
    { id: 'logo', name: 'logo.svg' },
    { id: 'pkg', name: 'package.json' },
    { id: 'readme', name: 'README.md' },
    { id: 'tsconf', name: 'tsconfig.json' },
    { id: 'home', name: 'Home.tsx' },
    { id: 'about', name: 'About.tsx' },
    { id: 'req', name: 'request.ts' },
    { id: 'fmt', name: 'format.ts' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'root', target: 'src' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'public' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'pkg' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'readme' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'tsconf' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'comp' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'pages' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'utils' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'app' },
    { source: 'src', target: 'index' },
    { source: 'comp', target: 'home' },
    { source: 'comp', target: 'about' },
    { source: 'utils', target: 'req' },
    { source: 'utils', target: 'fmt' },
    { source: 'public', target: 'assets' },
    { source: 'assets', target: 'logo' },
  ],
};

const NODE_W = 120;
const NODE_H = 28;
const FONT_SIZE = 12;
const CHAR_WIDTH = FONT_SIZE * 0.5;
const NODE_PADDING = 2;

/** Measure text width in graph units (approximate) */
function measureTextWidth(text: string): number {
  return text.length * CHAR_WIDTH + NODE_PADDING;
}

const layoutBase = {
  type: 'indented' as const,
  indent: 80,
  rowHeight: 52,
  direction: 'LR' as const,
};

const edgeBase = {
  type: 'polyline' as const,
  style: {
    lineWidth: 2,
    router: 'indented' as const,
    radius: 24,
    endArrow: false,
    startArrow: false,
  },
};

// ── 模式一：所有节点有背景色 ────────────────────────
function configStyled() {
  return {
    node: {
      type: 'rect' as const,
      style: {
        fill: (n: any) => n.data?._nodeColor ?? '#5B8FF9',
        width: NODE_W,
        height: NODE_H,
        borderRadius: 4,
        opacity: 0.9,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      ...edgeBase,
      style: {
        ...edgeBase.style,
        stroke: (src: any) => src.data?._edgeColor ?? '#c0c0c0',
      },
    },
    layout: {
      ...layoutBase,
      nodeColors: ['#4A90D9', '#F08F56', '#00C9C9', '#D580FF', '#7863FF'],
      edgeColors: ['#1783FF', '#F08F56', '#00C9C9', '#D580FF', '#7863FF'],
    },
    labelColor: '#fff' as any,
    labelPosition: 'inside' as const,
  };
}

// ── 模式二：子节点无样式（设计稿风格）──────────────────
// 参考 G6 IndentedNode：节点宽度 = 固定间距 + 文字宽度
// 边到达节点右边缘（覆盖文字长度），文字从左边缘开始，边长度随文字自适应
function configMinimal() {
  return {
    node: {
      type: 'rect' as const,
      style: {
        fill: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? '#4A90D9' : '#ffffff',
        width: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? NODE_W : measureTextWidth(n.name ?? n.id),
        height: NODE_H,
        borderRadius: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? 6 : 0,
        stroke: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? '#4A90D9' : '#ffffff',
        strokeWidth: 0,
        opacity: (n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? 1 : 0,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      ...edgeBase,
      style: {
        ...edgeBase.style,
        stroke: (src: any) => src.data?._edgeColor ?? '#c0c0c0',
        indentTarget: 'right' as const,
      },
    },
    layout: {
      ...layoutBase,
      edgeColors: ['#1783FF', '#F08F56', '#00C9C9', '#D580FF', '#7863FF'],
    },
    labelColor: ((n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? '#fff' : '#333') as any,
    labelPosition: ((n: any) => n.data?._isRoot ? 'inside' : 'right') as any,
  };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'indented', indented);
  const wrapper =
    typeof container === 'string'
      ? (document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement)
      : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  let currentGraph: Graph | null = null;
  let cleanupLabels: (() => void) | undefined;
  let generation = 0;
  let disposed = false;
  let currentMode = 'styled';

  async function renderMode(mode: string) {
    const token = ++generation;
    cleanupLabels?.();
    cleanupLabels = undefined;
    if (currentGraph) {
      currentGraph.destroy();
      // Remove old label canvas
      const oldLabel = wrapper.querySelector('.label-canvas');
      if (oldLabel) oldLabel.remove();
    }
    currentMode = mode;

    const cfg = mode === 'styled' ? configStyled() : configMinimal();

    const graph = new Graph({
      autoFit: true,
      container: wrapper,
      data: JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(data)),
      node: cfg.node as any,
      edge: cfg.edge as any,
      layout: cfg.layout,
      behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
      theme: 'light',
    });

    currentGraph = graph;
    await graph.render();
    if (disposed || token !== generation) { graph.destroy(); return; }

    const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
    const labelColorFn = cfg.labelColor;
    const labelPosition = cfg.labelPosition;
    const isMinimal = currentMode === 'minimal';
    cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
      nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
      position: labelPosition,
      nodeSize: (n: any) => {
        if (isMinimal && !n.data?._isRoot) {
          return { width: measureTextWidth(n.name ?? n.id), height: NODE_H };
        }
        return { width: NODE_W, height: NODE_H };
      },
      fontSize: FONT_SIZE,
      color: labelColorFn,
    });

    currentGraph = graph;
  }

  await renderMode('styled');
  const ui = createDemoPanel(wrapper);
  ui.addChoice('样式', { 有背景: 'styled', 无样式: 'minimal' }, 'styled', (value) => {
    if (value !== currentMode) void renderMode(value);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => currentGraph?.getData(),
    fitView: () => currentGraph?.fitView(),
    destroy: () => {
      disposed = true;
      generation++;
      cleanupLabels?.();
      if (currentGraph) currentGraph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)
