# Label rendering policy (/en/docs/examples/label-rendering-options)





Compare fixed size, low-zoom drawing, and collision hiding.

## Try it

Starts with all labels at zoom 0.4. Choose the default policy and zoom 0.2 to hide text; switch back to all labels at the same zoom to show it again. Refresh restores the initial settings.

## Data

The same graph switches between the default policy and showing every label.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const NODES = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, index) => ({
  id: `service-${index + 1}`,
  x: (index % 6) * 160,
  y: Math.floor(index / 6) * 180,
  data: {
    label: `Service ${String(index + 1).padStart(2, '0')}`,
    fill: ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16'][Math.floor(index / 6)],
  },
}));

const EDGES = NODES.slice(1).map((node, index) => ({
  id: `route-${index + 1}`,
  source: NODES[index].id,
  target: node.id,
  data: { label: `route ${index + 1}` },
}));

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root =
    typeof container === 'string' ? (document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement) : container;
  // Reserve left room for the bottom-left status block. Scale the reservation
  // with the container so narrow hosts (e.g. the docs site preview) are not
  // squeezed against the right edge while wide canvases keep the full gap.
  const leftReserve = Math.round(Math.min(360, Math.max(160, root.clientWidth * 0.28)));
  const viewPadding: [number, number, number, number] = [90, 70, 70, leftReserve];
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: viewPadding, maxZoom: 0.4 },
    container: root,
    data: { nodes: NODES, edges: EDGES },
    label: {
      scaleWithZoom: false,
      hideOnLowZoom: false,
      hideOnCollision: false,
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 30,
        fill: (node) => String(node.data?.fill ?? '#5B8FF9'),
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
        labelColor: '#1e293b',
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.9)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 3,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      style: {
        stroke: '#94a3b8',
        endArrow: true,
        label: (_source, _target, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? edge.id ?? ''),
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelColor: '#475569',
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.88)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 2,
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(root);

  let allLabels = true;
  let zoom = 0.4;

  const updateStatus = () => {
    ui.setStatus(
      `${allLabels ? '全部标签：三项策略关闭' : '默认策略：三项策略开启'}\n` +
        `zoom=${zoom.toFixed(1)}\n` +
        `${allLabels ? '固定字号 · 不做低 zoom 隐藏 · 不做碰撞隐藏' : '字号随 zoom · 节点<0.3/边<0.5 隐藏 · 碰撞隐藏'}`,
    );
  };

  const setZoom = (nextZoom: number) => {
    zoom = nextZoom;
    graph.fitView({ padding: viewPadding, minZoom: zoom, maxZoom: zoom });
    updateStatus();
  };

  const setLabelPolicy = (showAll: boolean) => {
    allLabels = showAll;
    graph.updateOptions({
      label: {
        scaleWithZoom: !showAll,
        hideOnLowZoom: !showAll,
        hideOnCollision: !showAll,
      },
    });
    updateStatus();
  };

  ui.addAction('全部标签', () => setLabelPolicy(true));
  ui.addAction('默认策略', () => setLabelPolicy(false));
  ui.addAction('zoom 0.2', () => setZoom(0.2));
  ui.addAction('zoom 0.4', () => setZoom(0.4));
  ui.addAction('zoom 1.0', () => setZoom(1));

  setZoom(zoom);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => setZoom(zoom),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Labels and icons](/en/docs/guides/label)
- [Label policy](/en/docs/api/options#options-label)

# Label placement and icons (/en/docs/examples/labels)





Show node labels, edge labels, and icons, and change their placement at runtime.

## Try it

Set the label position to left in the top-right panel, then use the buttons to toggle node icons and edge labels. Refresh to restore the defaults.

## Data

Nodes have icons and labels. Edge labels can be toggled.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: 节点标签 / 边标签 / 节点图标
 */
import { Graph, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode, type LabelPlacement } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const DATA = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'server', data: { name: 'API Server', type: 'server' } },
    { id: 'db', data: { name: 'Database', type: 'database' } },
    { id: 'cache', data: { name: 'Redis Cache', type: 'cache' } },
    { id: 'queue', data: { name: 'Message Queue', type: 'queue' } },
    { id: 'worker', data: { name: 'Worker', type: 'worker' } },
    { id: 'gateway', data: { name: 'API Gateway', type: 'gateway' } },
    { id: 'client', data: { name: 'Client App', type: 'client' } },
    { id: 'monitor', data: { name: 'Monitor', type: 'monitor' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'client', target: 'gateway', data: { label: 'HTTPS' } },
    { source: 'gateway', target: 'server', data: { label: 'gRPC' } },
    { source: 'server', target: 'db', data: { label: 'SQL' } },
    { source: 'server', target: 'cache', data: { label: 'TCP' } },
    { source: 'server', target: 'queue', data: { label: 'AMQP' } },
    { source: 'queue', target: 'worker', data: { label: 'consume' } },
    { source: 'worker', target: 'db', data: { label: 'write' } },
    { source: 'monitor', target: 'server', data: { label: 'metrics' } },
    { source: 'monitor', target: 'gateway', data: { label: 'health' } },
  ],
};

// Text icons use the first letter of each node's business type.
const iconForNode = (node: GraphNode) => String(node.data?.type ?? '').slice(0, 1).toUpperCase();

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const el = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;

  el.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: el,
    data: DATA,
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 180 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 20,
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        icon: iconForNode,
        iconType: 'text',
        iconFontSize: 12,
        iconColor: '#fff',
        label: (n) => (n.data?.name as string | undefined) ?? n.id,
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
        labelColor: '#333',
      },
    },
    edge: {
      style: {
        label: (s, t, e) => (e.data?.label as string) ?? '',
        labelFontSize: 10,
        labelColor: '#666',
        labelAutoRotate: true,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(el);
  ui.addChoice<LabelPlacement>('标签', ['bottom', 'center', 'top', 'left', 'right'], 'bottom', (value) => {
    graph.updateOptions({ node: { style: { labelPlacement: value } } });
  });

  let edgeLabelsVisible = true;
  let iconsVisible = true;
  ui.addAction('切换边标签', () => {
    edgeLabelsVisible = !edgeLabelsVisible;
    graph.updateOptions({
      edge: {
        style: {
          label: edgeLabelsVisible
            ? ((_source: GraphNode, _target: GraphNode, edge: GraphEdge) =>
                (edge.data?.label as string | undefined) ?? '')
            : false,
        },
      },
    });
  });
  ui.addAction('切换节点图标', () => {
    iconsVisible = !iconsVisible;
    graph.updateOptions({ node: { style: { icon: iconsVisible ? iconForNode : false } } });
  });
  ui.addChoice('布局', ['circular', 'force'], 'circular', async (value) => {
    graph.setLayout(value === 'circular' ? { type: 'circular', radius: 180 } : { type: 'd3-force' });
    await graph.layout();
    graph.fitView();
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

## Steps and expected results [#steps-and-expected-results]

1. White letters at node centers are `iconType: 'text'` icons derived from each business `type`. Node names start below the nodes; edge labels show protocol names.
2. In the 标签 (label) menu at the top right of the canvas, choose `top`, `left`, or `right`. Names move to that side while icons remain centered. Choosing `center` may overlap labels and icons because they share the center.
3. In the panel, click 切换节点图标 (toggle node icons). The letters disappear while names remain. Click again to restore the letters. 切换边标签 (toggle edge labels) affects protocol names only.

The panel calls `graph.updateOptions()` to update icons, node labels, and edge labels independently. Use the 布局 (layout) dropdown to compare labels across layouts.

See the [label and icon guide](/en/docs/guides/label), [node label fields](/en/docs/guides/node#labels), and [icon fields](/en/docs/guides/node#icons). For global scaling and collision behavior, try [label rendering policy](/en/docs/examples/label-rendering-options).


## Related documentation

- [Labels and icons](/en/docs/guides/label)
- [Node reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-node)

# 5,000 labeled nodes (/en/docs/examples/large-labeled)





Draw canvas labels on a 5,000-node graph.

## Try it

Zoom out for the whole graph, then zoom in to read labels.

## Data

The synthetic network has 5,000 nodes and 15,000 edges. Built-in Canvas labels hide at low zoom and avoid collisions; zoom in to read them.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 5000 节点 + 标签 — 性能与标签验证
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

function generateData(nodeCount: number, degree: number) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: nodeCount }, (_, i) => ({
    id: String(i),
    name: `N${i}`,
    data: { cluster: i % 3 === 0 ? 'a' : i % 3 === 1 ? 'b' : 'c' },
  }));
  const edges: Array<{ source: string; target: string; data: { label: string } }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
    const k = Math.min(degree, nodeCount - 1);
    for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) {
      const t = (i + 1 + j * 13) % nodeCount;
      if (t !== i) {
        edges.push({
          source: String(i),
          target: String(t),
          data: { label: `e${i}-${t}` },
        });
      }
    }
  }
  return { nodes, edges };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrap = typeof container === 'string' ? (document.querySelector(container) as HTMLElement) : container;
  const { nodes, edges } = generateData(5000, 3);

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrap,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => {
          const c = (d.data?.cluster as string) ?? 'a';
          return c === 'a' ? '#5B8FF9' : c === 'b' ? '#61DDAA' : '#F6BD16';
        },
        size: 4,
        label: (node) => node.name ?? node.id,
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
      },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 0.5 } },
    label: { scaleWithZoom: false, hideOnLowZoom: true, hideOnCollision: true },
    layout: { type: 'force', linkDistance: 25 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();

  return graph;
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Performance measurement](/en/docs/metrics/performance)
- [Performance tuning](/en/docs/metrics/performance#performance-tuning)

# 200 nodes (/en/docs/examples/large)





Inspect rendering and interaction on a 200-node graph.

## Try it

Zoom, pan, and hover a node to highlight its neighbors.

## Data

The synthetic network has 200 nodes and about 4 edges each.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 较大规模 — 较多节点边，验证基础性能
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

function generateData(nodeCount: number, edgeFactor: number) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: nodeCount }, (_, i) => ({
    id: String(i),
    data: { cluster: i % 3 === 0 ? 'a' : i % 3 === 1 ? 'b' : 'c' },
  }));
  const edges: Array<{ source: string; target: string }> = [];
  for (let i = 0; i < nodeCount; i++) {
    const k = Math.min(edgeFactor, nodeCount - 1);
    for (let j = 0; j < k; j++) {
      const t = (i + 1 + j) % nodeCount;
      if (t !== i) edges.push({ source: String(i), target: String(t) });
    }
  }
  return { nodes, edges };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const { nodes, edges } = generateData(200, 4);

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => {
          const c = (d.data?.cluster as string) ?? 'a';
          return c === 'a' ? '#5B8FF9' : c === 'b' ? '#61DDAA' : '#F6BD16';
        },
        size: 6,
      },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 1 } },
    layout: { type: 'force', linkDistance: 60 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

- [Performance measurement](/en/docs/metrics/performance)
- [Performance tuning](/en/docs/metrics/performance#performance-tuning)

# More layout examples (/en/docs/examples/layout-gallery)





Compare radial, concentric, ForceAtlas2, fruchterman, MDS, and random layouts.

## Try it

Choose layouts from the toolbar and inspect how the same data changes.

## Data

Use a fixed small network to compare six layout algorithms.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph, register, type LayoutConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import mds from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/mds';
import radial from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/radial';
import random from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/random';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const NODES = Array.from({ length: 18 }, (_, index) => ({ id: String(index), data: { label: String(index) } }));
const EDGES = Array.from({ length: 17 }, (_, index) => ({ id: `e-${index}`, source: String(Math.floor(index / 2)), target: String(index + 1) }));

const LAYOUTS: Array<{ label: string; config: LayoutConfig }> = [
  { label: 'Radial', config: { type: 'radial', unitRadius: 68, linkDistance: 60 } },
  { label: 'Concentric', config: { type: 'concentric', nodeSize: 28, minNodeSpacing: 18 } },
  { label: 'ForceAtlas2', config: { type: 'force-atlas2', maxIteration: 60, barnesHut: true, prune: false } },
  { label: 'Fruchterman', config: { type: 'fruchterman', maxIteration: 80, gravity: 8, speed: 5 } },
  { label: 'MDS', config: { type: 'mds', linkDistance: 70 } },
  { label: 'Random', config: { type: 'random' } },
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'mds', mds);
  register('layout', 'radial', radial);
  register('layout', 'random', random);
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes: NODES, edges: EDGES },
    layout: LAYOUTS[0].config,
    node: { style: { size: 24, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#94a3b8', endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 72 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const labels = LAYOUTS.map(({ label }) => label);
  ui.addChoice('布局', labels, labels[0], async (label) => {
    const layout = LAYOUTS[labels.indexOf(label)];
    ui.setStatus(`running ${label}…`);
    graph.setLayout(layout.config);
    await graph.layout();
    graph.fitView({ padding: 72 });
    ui.setStatus(`${label} complete\nnodes=${graph.getNodeCount()} edges=${graph.getEdgeCount()}`);
  });

  ui.setStatus('Radial complete');
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# Worker layout (/en/docs/examples/layout-worker)





Request a worker force layout and display the returned node positions.

## Try it

Pan the canvas after the force layout finishes.

## Data

80 nodes and 79 edges request background computation with worker: true. Verify actual worker execution in Network/Performance; failures may fall back.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: run a force layout in a Web Worker.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

function createNetwork(count: number) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: count }, (_, index) => ({
    id: `n${index}`,
    data: { group: index % 4 },
  }));
  const edges = nodes.slice(1).map((node, index) => ({
    source: `n${index % 8}`,
    target: node.id,
  }));
  return { nodes, edges };
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  host.style.position = 'relative';
  const started = performance.now();
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: host,
    data: createNetwork(80),
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 10,
        fill: (node) => ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#E86452'][Number(node.data?.group ?? 0)],
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#D0D7E2', lineWidth: 1 } },
    layout: { type: 'force', worker: true, linkDistance: 48, maxIteration: 80 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const ui = createDemoPanel(host);
  ui.setStatus(`force · worker requested · ${Math.round(performance.now() - started)} ms\nWorker success requires a Network/Performance check; failure may fall back.`);

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Worker guide](/en/docs/guides/layout-worker)
- [Layout methods](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-layout)

# Common layout switching (/en/docs/examples/layouts)





Switch between circular, force, grid, and dagre with the same data.

## Try it

Use the preview buttons to compare four layout results.

## Data

Hierarchical relationship data with 10 nodes and 11 edges.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: 布局 — 同一数据切换 circular / force / grid / dagre
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: '0' }, { id: '1' }, { id: '2' }, { id: '3' }, { id: '4' },
    { id: '5' }, { id: '6' }, { id: '7' }, { id: '8' }, { id: '9' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: '0', target: '1' }, { source: '0', target: '2' }, { source: '1', target: '3' },
    { source: '2', target: '4' }, { source: '3', target: '5' }, { source: '4', target: '5' },
    { source: '5', target: '6' }, { source: '6', target: '7' }, { source: '6', target: '8' },
    { source: '7', target: '9' }, { source: '8', target: '9' },
  ],
};

const LAYOUTS = [
  { type: 'circular', radius: 180 },
  { type: 'force', linkDistance: 80 },
  { type: 'grid', rows: 2, cols: 5 },
  { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'TB', nodesep: 30, ranksep: 40 },
] as const;

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  let currentGraph: Graph | null = null;
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string'
    ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)!
    : container;
  wrapper.replaceChildren();
  wrapper.style.cssText = 'position:relative;width:100%;height:100%;min-height:0;';

  const canvasParent = document.createElement('div');
  canvasParent.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;inset:0;';
  wrapper.appendChild(canvasParent);

  async function renderLayout(index: number) {
    currentGraph?.destroy();
    const layout = LAYOUTS[index];
    currentGraph = new Graph({
      autoFit: true,
      container: canvasParent,
      data,
      node: { type: 'circle', style: { size: 10 } },
      edge: { type: 'line', style: { endArrow: true } },
      layout: { ...layout },
      behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-node'],
      theme: 'light',
    });
    await currentGraph.render();
  }

  await renderLayout(0);

  const ui = createDemoPanel(wrapper);
  const labels = ['Circular', 'Force', 'Grid', 'Dagre'];
  ui.addChoice('布局', labels, labels[0], (value) => {
    void renderLayout(labels.indexOf(value));
  });

  return {
    getData: () => currentGraph?.getData(),
    fitView: () => currentGraph?.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      currentGraph?.destroy();
      currentGraph = null;
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# Mind map (/en/docs/examples/mindmap)





Organize knowledge around a central topic with two-sided, labeled, colored branches.

## Try it

Zoom or pan to read topic branches and fit the complete mind map.

## Data

Illustrative typhoon formation factors with 12 topic nodes and 11 branch edges.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 思维导图 (Mind Map) — 台风形成因素
 */
import { Graph, register, type GraphEdge, type GraphNode } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import mindmap from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/mindmap';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const BRANCH_COLORS = ['#E8684A', '#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16'];

// 节点层级定义
const NODE_LEVELS = {
  ROOT: 'root',
  LEVEL1: 'level1',
  CHILD: 'child',
};

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'root', name: '台风形成的因素', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.ROOT } },
    // 左侧 - 地理环境
    { id: 'left1', name: '地理环境', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-1', name: '海温', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-2', name: '海洋面积', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-3', name: '赤道气流影响', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-4', name: '海水蒸发量', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    { id: 'left1-5', name: '热带海域海表温度分布特征', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 0 } },
    // 右侧 - 气象条件
    { id: 'right1', name: '气象条件', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-1', name: '气压', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-2', name: '风速切变', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-3', name: '湿度条件', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
    { id: 'right1-4', name: '大气环流模式', data: { level: NODE_LEVELS.CHILD, branch: 1 } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'root', target: 'left1' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-1' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-2' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-3' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-4' },
    { source: 'left1', target: 'left1-5' },
    { source: 'root', target: 'right1' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-1' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-2' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-3' },
    { source: 'right1', target: 'right1-4' },
  ],
};

// 获取节点尺寸 - 根据文字长度动态计算
function getNodeSize(node: { name?: string; data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const name = node.name || '';
  const charWidth = 14; // 每个字符的宽度
  const padding = 20; // 左右内边距
  const minWidth = 60;
  const calculatedWidth = Math.max(minWidth, name.length * charWidth + padding);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.ROOT) {
    return { width: 140, height: 44 };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1) {
    return { width: Math.max(100, name.length * charWidth + padding), height: 36 };
  }
  return { width: calculatedWidth, height: 30 };
}

// 获取节点样式 - 匹配设计稿
function getNodeStyle(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  const branch = node.data?.branch as number | undefined;
  const branchColor = branch !== undefined ? BRANCH_COLORS[branch % BRANCH_COLORS.length] : '#5B8FF9';
  const size = getNodeSize(node);

  if (level === NODE_LEVELS.ROOT) {
    // 根节点：深蓝填充，白色文字，无边框
    return {
      fill: '#294172',
      width: size.width,
      height: size.height,
      borderRadius: 12,
      stroke: 'transparent',
      strokeWidth: 0,
    };
  } else if (level === NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1) {
    // 一级节点：分支色填充，白色文字
    return {
      fill: branchColor,
      width: size.width,
      height: size.height,
      borderRadius: 10,
      stroke: 'transparent',
      strokeWidth: 0,
    };
  } else {
    // 子节点：白色填充，灰色边框，黑色文字
    return {
      fill: '#fff',
      width: size.width,
      height: size.height,
      borderRadius: 8,
      stroke: '#d9d9d9',
      strokeWidth: 1,
    };
  }
}

// 获取节点文字颜色
function getNodeLabelColor(node: { data?: Record<string, unknown> }) {
  const level = node.data?.level as string;
  // 根节点和一级节点用白色文字，子节点用黑色文字
  return level === NODE_LEVELS.CHILD ? '#333' : '#fff';
}

// 获取边颜色
function getEdgeColor(_source: GraphNode, _target: GraphNode, edge: GraphEdge) {
  const sourceNode = data.nodes.find(n => n.id === edge.source);
  const branch = sourceNode?.data?.branch as number | undefined;
  return branch !== undefined ? BRANCH_COLORS[branch % BRANCH_COLORS.length] : '#5B8FF9';
}

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'mindmap', mindmap);
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: (n) => getNodeStyle(n),
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'cubic',
      style: {
        stroke: getEdgeColor,
        lineWidth: 1,
        curveOffset: 60,
      },
    },
    layout: {
      type: 'mindmap',
      direction: 'H',
      levelGap: 120,  // 缩短左右间距
      nodeGap: 12,
      branchColors: BRANCH_COLORS,
      getWidth: (n: GraphNode) => getNodeSize(n).width,
      getHeight: (n: GraphNode) => getNodeSize(n).height,
      getSide: (n: GraphNode, index: number) => {
        // 一级子节点交替分配到左右
        const branch = n.data?.branch as number | undefined;
        if (branch !== undefined) {
          return branch % 2 === 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
        }
        return index % 2 === 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
      },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 64 });

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: 'inside',
    nodeSize: (n) => {
      const size = getNodeSize(n);
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      return { width: size.width / dpr, height: size.height / dpr };
    },
    fontSize: (n) => {
      const level = n.data?.level as string;
      return level === NODE_LEVELS.ROOT ? 20 : level === NODE_LEVELS.LEVEL1 ? 16 : 14;
    },
    color: (n) => getNodeLabelColor(n),
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => { cleanupLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# One-hop highlight (/en/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight)





Highlight a node with its neighbors, or an edge with its endpoints.

## Try it

Hover a node or an edge.

## Data

Seven nodes and seven edges form a hub with two branch levels for one-hop highlighting.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: hover a node to highlight its neighbors, or an edge to highlight its endpoints.
 */
import { Graph, register } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import radial from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/radial';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'radial', radial);
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: ['hub', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e', 'f'].map((id) => ({ id, data: { label: id.toUpperCase() } })),
      edges: [
        { source: 'hub', target: 'a' },
        { source: 'hub', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'hub', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'e' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'f' },
        { source: 'd', target: 'e' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: (node) => (node.id === 'hub' ? 36 : 24),
        fill: (node) => (node.id === 'hub' ? '#E86452' : '#5B8FF9'),
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#C5CEDB', lineWidth: 2 } },
    layout: { type: 'radial', unitRadius: 120, linkDistance: 100 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node', 'highlight-edge'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

# Node stroke and radius (/en/docs/examples/node-border)





Adjust stroke, width, and rectangle corner radius.

## Try it

Inspect stroke widths and corner radii.

## Data

The upper circles compare stroke widths and colors; lower rectangles compare radii 0, 4, 8 and 14. Data is exported for both views.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Node border + rounded rect
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const root = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  const graphs: Graph[] = [];

  // Circle nodes with stroke
  const div1 = document.createElement('div');
  div1.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  div1.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;';
  root.appendChild(div1);

  const g1 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: div1,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'c1', name: 'No stroke', x: 100, y: 80 },
        { id: 'c2', name: 'Thin stroke', x: 250, y: 80 },
        { id: 'c3', name: 'Thick stroke', x: 400, y: 80 },
        { id: 'c4', name: 'Colored', x: 550, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        size: 36,
        stroke: (d) => d.id === 'c4' ? '#F08F56' : '#fff',
        strokeWidth: (d) => d.id === 'c1' ? 0 : d.id === 'c2' ? 2 : d.id === 'c3' ? 4 : 3,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g1.render();
  graphs.push(g1);

  // Rect nodes with border radius
  const div2 = document.createElement('div');
  div2.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  div2.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;margin-top:16px;';
  root.appendChild(div2);

  const g2 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: div2,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'r1', name: 'Sharp rect', x: 100, y: 80 },
        { id: 'r2', name: 'Rounded 4px', x: 280, y: 80 },
        { id: 'r3', name: 'Rounded 8px', x: 460, y: 80 },
        { id: 'r4', name: 'Pill', x: 640, y: 80 },
      ],
      edges: [],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 60,
        height: 28,
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        borderRadius: (d) => d.id === 'r1' ? 0 : d.id === 'r2' ? 4 : d.id === 'r3' ? 8 : 14,
      },
    },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await g2.render();
  graphs.push(g2);

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: graphs.map((graph) => graph.getData()) }),
    fitView: () => graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.fitView()),
    destroy: () => {
      graphs.forEach((graph) => graph.destroy());
      div1.remove(); div2.remove();
    },
  };
}
```

- [Node reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-node)

    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: '0', name: 'A', data: { cluster: 'a' } },

        { id: '2', name: 'C', data: { cluster: 'a' } },
        { id: '3', name: 'D', data: { cluster: 'b' } },
        { id: '4', name: 'E', data: { cluster: 'a' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: '0', target: '1' },
        { source: '0', target: '2' },

        { source: '2', target: '4' },
        { source: '3', target: '4' },
      ],

      type: 'circle',

        fill: (d) => (d.data?.cluster === 'a' ? '#5B8FF9' : '#61DDAA'),

# Organization chart (/en/docs/examples/org-chart)





Show reporting relationships with hierarchical layout, rectangle nodes, and tree edges.

## Try it

Zoom or pan to inspect reporting levels and fit the complete structure.

## Data

An illustrative technology company with 6 role or team nodes and 5 reporting edges.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 组织架构图 — 科技公司 (dagre TB + 大矩形节点 + 多行文字自动换行 + 曲线树边)
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const LEVEL_COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  ceo: '#4A7DC0',
  vp: '#E8944A',
  team: '#D45B5B',
};

const NODE_W = 180;
const NODE_H = 70;

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'ceo', name: 'CEO', data: { title: '首席执行官', level: 'ceo' } },
    { id: 'cto', name: 'CTO', data: { title: '首席技术官', level: 'vp' } },
    { id: 'cfo', name: 'CFO', data: { title: '首席财务官', level: 'vp' } },
    { id: 'coo', name: 'COO', data: { title: '首席运营官', level: 'vp' } },
    { id: 'fe', name: '前端团队', data: { title: '负责人：张工', level: 'team' } },
    { id: 'be', name: '后端团队', data: { title: '负责人：李工', level: 'team' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'ceo', target: 'cto' },
    { source: 'ceo', target: 'cfo' },
    { source: 'ceo', target: 'coo' },
    { source: 'cto', target: 'fe' },
    { source: 'cto', target: 'be' },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: (n) => LEVEL_COLORS[n.data?.level as string] ?? '#5B8FF9',
        width: NODE_W,
        height: NODE_H,
        borderRadius: 8,
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'polyline',
      style: {
        stroke: '#c0c0c0',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        router: 'tree',
        endArrow: false,
        startArrow: false,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'TB', nodesep: 50, ranksep: 80, nodeSize: [NODE_W, NODE_H] },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 64 });

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => `${n.name}\n${n.data?.title ?? ''}`,
    position: 'inside',
    nodeSize: () => {
      const dpr = Math.min(2, window.devicePixelRatio || 1);
      return { width: NODE_W / dpr, height: NODE_H / dpr };
    },
    fontSize: 13,
    color: '#fff',
    secondaryColor: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.8)',
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => { cleanupLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# Parallel and reverse edges (/en/docs/examples/parallel-edges)





Separate same-direction parallel edges, reverse edges, and single edges automatically.

## Try it

Drag nodes, hover, and select edges to inspect curves and labels.

## Data

Four nodes and seven edges, including six parallel or reverse edges.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: process-parallel-edges
 */
import { Graph, type TooltipContext } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    // Padding keeps arc-apex edge labels and bottom node labels inside view.
    autoFit: { padding: 56 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'source', name: 'Source', x: 180, y: 220 },
        { id: 'target', name: 'Target', x: 520, y: 220 },
        { id: 'singleA', name: 'Single A', x: 180, y: 420 },
        { id: 'singleB', name: 'Single B', x: 520, y: 420 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'e1', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'approve' } },
        { id: 'e2', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'reject' } },
        { id: 'e3', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'review' } },
        { id: 'e4', source: 'source', target: 'target', data: { label: 'archive' } },
        { id: 'r1', source: 'target', target: 'source', data: { label: 'rollback' } },
        { id: 'r2', source: 'target', target: 'source', data: { label: 'notify' } },
        { id: 'single', source: 'singleA', target: 'singleB', data: { label: 'single edge' } },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        size: 34,
        fill: (node) => (node.id.startsWith('single') ? '#36B37E' : '#5B8FF9'),
        stroke: '#ffffff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
        label: (node) => node.name ?? node.id,
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
        labelFontSize: 12,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      parallelEdges: {
        enabled: true,
        offset: 26,
        includeReverse: true,
      },
      style: {
        stroke: (_s, _t, edge) => (edge.source === 'target' ? '#F08F56' : '#6B8FF8'),
        endArrow: true,
        arrowSize: 12,
        label: (_s, _t, edge) => String(edge.data?.label ?? ''),
        labelFontSize: 11,
        labelBackground: 'rgba(255,255,255,0.92)',
        labelBackgroundPadding: 4,
        labelAutoRotate: true,
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { stroke: '#F4664A', lineWidth: 2 },
        active: { stroke: '#00A3A3' },
      },
    },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      'drag-node',
      'hover-highlight',
      'click-select',
      {
        type: 'tooltip',
        trigger: 'hover',
        getContent: (ctx: TooltipContext) => {
          if (ctx.itemType === 'edge') {
            const label = (ctx.data as { label?: string } | undefined)?.label ?? ctx.edgeId;
            return `${ctx.source} -> ${ctx.target}<br/><span style="color:#8c8c8c">${label}</span>`;
          }
          return String(ctx.nodeId);
        },
      },
    ],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```

# Polyline orthogonal routing (/en/docs/examples/polyline-routing)

/**
 * Demo: orthogonal polyline edges with rounded corners.

import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'request', data: { label: '请求' } },
        { id: 'auth', data: { label: '鉴权' } },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: '缓存' } },
        { id: 'service', data: { label: '服务' } },
        { id: 'db', data: { label: '数据库' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'request', target: 'auth' },
        { source: 'auth', target: 'cache' },
        { source: 'auth', target: 'service' },
        { source: 'service', target: 'db' },
        { source: 'cache', target: 'db' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 88,
        height: 36,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),

        labelColor: '#fff',

      style: {

        endArrow: true,
        radius: 12,
        router: 'orth',
      },

    layout: { type: 'dagre', rankdir: 'LR', nodesep: 28, ranksep: 72, nodeSize: [88, 36] },

}

# Queries, batch states, and visibility (/en/docs/examples/queries-and-states)





Inspect elements, adjacency, and states while controlling batch states and visibility.

## Try it

Query root for neighbors n1/n2 and two adjacent edges. Compare batch toggles, replacing states for specified IDs, Combo highlighting and hiding. Unspecified IDs retain their states; clear restores empty states.

## Data

Use connected graph data to validate the Graph query model.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const DATA: GraphData = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'root', x: 180, y: 160, comboId: 'left', data: { label: 'Root' } },
    { id: 'n1', x: 340, y: 90, comboId: 'right', data: { label: 'N1' } },
    { id: 'n2', x: 340, y: 230, comboId: 'right', data: { label: 'N2' } },
    { id: 'n3', x: 500, y: 160, data: { label: 'N3' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { id: 'e-root-n1', source: 'root', target: 'n1' },
    { id: 'e-root-n2', source: 'root', target: 'n2' },
    { id: 'e-n1-n3', source: 'n1', target: 'n3' },
    { id: 'e-n2-n3', source: 'n2', target: 'n3' },
  ],
  combos: [
    { id: 'left', data: { label: '查询起点' } },
    { id: 'right', data: { label: '状态分组' } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: DATA,
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 32,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
      stateStyles: {
        selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 3 },
        active: { fill: '#13C2C2', stroke: '#08979C', strokeWidth: 3 },
        highlight: { fill: '#FA8C16', stroke: '#D46B08', strokeWidth: 3 },
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#94a3b8', endArrow: true } },
    combo: { style: { padding: 24, label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.label ?? combo.id) } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  const showStateSummary = (prefix: string) => {
    ui.setStatus(
      `${prefix}\nselected nodes=${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || '-'}\n` +
        `active edges=${graph.findEdgesByState('active').join(', ') || '-'}\n` +
        `highlight combos=${graph.findCombosByState('highlight').join(', ') || '-'}`,
    );
  };

  ui.addAction('查询 root', () => {
    const element = graph.getElementData('root');
    const position = graph.getElementPosition('root');
    ui.setStatus(
      `hasNode=${graph.hasNode('root')} hasEdge=${graph.hasEdge('e-root-n1')} hasElement=${graph.hasElement('right')}\n` +
        `element=${element?.id} position=${position?.x},${position?.y}\n` +
        `neighbors=${graph.getNeighborNodes('root').join(', ')}\n` +
        `adjacent=${graph.getAdjacentEdges('root').map((edge) => edge.id).join(', ')}`,
    );
  });
  ui.addAction('批量设状态', () => {
    graph.batchSetState([
      { id: 'root', state: 'selected', value: true },
      { id: 'n3', state: 'selected', value: true },
      { id: 'e-root-n1', state: 'active', value: true },
    ]);
    showStateSummary('batchSetState');
  });
  ui.addAction('替换状态', () => {
    graph.setElementStates({ root: ['highlight'], n1: ['selected'], 'e-root-n2': ['active'] });
    showStateSummary('setElementStates');
  });
  ui.addAction('Combo 状态', () => {
    graph.setItemState('right', 'highlight', true);
    const children = graph.getComboChildren('right');
    ui.setStatus(`combo=${graph.getComboData('right')?.id}\nchildren=${children.nodes.join(', ')}\nstates=${graph.getItemStates('right').join(', ')}`);
  });
  ui.addAction('隐藏 n2', () => {
    const hidden = graph.getItemStates('n2').includes('hidden');
    if (hidden) graph.showItem('n2');
    else graph.hideItem('n2');
    ui.setStatus(`n2 states=${graph.getItemStates('n2').join(', ') || '-'}`);
  });
  ui.addAction('全部清理', () => {
    for (const node of graph.getNodes()) graph.clearItemStates(node.id);
    for (const edge of graph.getEdges()) graph.clearItemStates(edge.id);
    for (const comboId of ['left', 'right']) graph.clearItemStates(comboId);
    showStateSummary('clearItemStates');
  });

  showStateSummary('ready');
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Queries and adjacency](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-data)
- [States and visibility](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-states)
- [Combo operations](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-combo)

# Radial tree (/en/docs/examples/radial-tree)





Place a topic tree around a center node with the radial layout.

## Try it

Zoom to inspect the center topic and its branches.

## Data

A 10-node topic tree is arranged around its root.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: a topic tree laid out with the radial algorithm.
 */
import { Graph, register } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import radial from '@antv/g6-lite/layouts/radial';

const TREE: Array<[string, string, string?]> = [
  ['root', '产品'],
  ['research', '研究', 'root'],
  ['design', '设计', 'root'],
  ['build', '研发', 'root'],
  ['interview', '访谈', 'research'],
  ['metrics', '指标', 'research'],
  ['flow', '流程', 'design'],
  ['visual', '视觉', 'design'],
  ['api', '接口', 'build'],
  ['test', '测试', 'build'],
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  register('layout', 'radial', radial);
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 32 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: TREE.map(([id, label]) => ({ id, data: { label, root: id === 'root' } })),
      edges: TREE.filter((item) => item[2]).map(([id, , parent]) => ({ source: parent!, target: id })),
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: (node) => (node.data?.root ? 46 : 28),
        fill: (node) => (node.data?.root ? '#E86452' : '#5B8FF9'),
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { stroke: '#C5CEDB', lineWidth: 1.5 } },
    layout: { type: 'radial', unitRadius: 110, linkDistance: 90, nodeSize: 28 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  return graph;
}
```

- [Layout selection](/en/docs/guides/layout)
- [Layout reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-layout)

# AI Papers large relationship graph (/en/docs/examples/real-dataset)





Validate large-graph rendering and interaction with a real paper citation network.

## Try it

Zoom, pan, and hover nodes to inspect interaction on a large relationship graph.

## Data

The AI Papers dataset contains 8,798 nodes and 71,077 edges with precomputed ForceAtlas2 coordinates.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 真实数据集 — sigma.js 官网首页同款数据
 *
 * 两个数据集来自 sigma.js 官方仓库(MIT),由 scripts/fetch-sigma-datasets.mjs 转换:
 *  - wikipedia.json   2085 节点 / 5409 边   (v3 官网首页:数据可视化维基百科网络)
 *  - ai-papers.json   8798 节点 / 71077 边  (v4 官网首页:高被引 AI 论文引用网络)
 *
 * 节点自带 sigma 预跑好的 ForceAtlas2 坐标,这里直接复用预置布局(不重跑 layout),
 * 用于横向对比 G6Lite 与 sigma.js 在相同真实数据上的渲染表现。
 */
import { Graph, type GraphData } from '@antv/g6-lite';

// 切换这里即可换数据集
const DATASET = new URL('./datasets/ai-papers.json', import.meta.url).href;

// 聚类调色板(cluster -> color),覆盖两个数据集的常见 class 数量
const PALETTE = [
  '#5B8FF9', '#61DDAA', '#F6BD16', '#7262FD', '#78D3F8',
  '#9661BC', '#F6903D', '#008685', '#F08BB4', '#E8684A',
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const data: GraphData = await fetch(DATASET).then((r) => r.json());
  // Uniformly rescale the precomputed layout to keep node bodies visible at fit.
  // Relative positions and the original network topology remain unchanged.
  data.nodes = data.nodes.map((node) => ({ ...node, x: (node.x ?? 0) * 0.02, y: (node.y ?? 0) * 0.02 }));
  const fitOptions = { padding: 32 };

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: fitOptions,
    container,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        // 优先用数据自带 color(wikipedia),否则按 cluster 取色板(ai-papers)
        fill: (d) => {
          const c = d.data?.color as string | undefined;
          if (c) return c;
          const idx = parseInt((d.data?.cluster as string) ?? '0', 10) || 0;
          return PALETTE[idx % PALETTE.length];
        },
        size: 4,
      },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { lineWidth: 0.4, stroke: '#ccc' } },
    // 复用预置坐标:不配置 layout
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(fitOptions),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Performance measurement](/en/docs/metrics/performance)
- [Performance tuning](/en/docs/metrics/performance#performance-tuning)

# Character relationship network (/en/docs/examples/relationship)





Explore a force-directed network with character nodes and relationship labels.

## Try it

Zoom or pan the canvas, hover characters to highlight connections, and fit the full graph.

## Data

An illustrative Harry Potter character network with 8 nodes and 10 labeled edges.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository provide example label overlays.
/**
 * Demo: 人物关系网络图 — 哈利波特角色关系 (force 布局 + 边标签)
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { attachLabelsCanvas, attachEdgeLabelsCanvas, type GraphInstanceWithTools } from './tooling.ts';

const COLORS: Record<string, string> = {
  gryffindor: '#5B8FF9',
  friend: '#F6BD16',
  enemy: '#30BF78',
  mentor: '#E86452',
};

const data = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'harry', name: '哈利·波特', data: { house: 'gryffindor' } },
    { id: 'ron', name: '罗恩·韦斯莱', data: { house: 'friend' } },
    { id: 'hermione', name: '赫敏·格兰杰', data: { house: 'mentor' } },
    { id: 'voldemort', name: '伏地魔', data: { house: 'enemy' } },
    { id: 'dumbledore', name: '邓布利多', data: { house: 'mentor' } },
    { id: 'snape', name: '斯内普', data: { house: 'friend' } },
    { id: 'draco', name: '德拉科', data: { house: 'enemy' } },
    { id: 'sirius', name: '小天狼星', data: { house: 'friend' } },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'ron', target: 'harry', data: { label: '朋友' } },
    { source: 'hermione', target: 'harry', data: { label: '朋友' } },
    { source: 'harry', target: 'voldemort', data: { label: '试图杀死' } },
    { source: 'dumbledore', target: 'harry', data: { label: '导师' } },
    { source: 'snape', target: 'harry', data: { label: '保护' } },
    { source: 'draco', target: 'harry', data: { label: '敌对' } },
    { source: 'sirius', target: 'harry', data: { label: '教父' } },
    { source: 'ron', target: 'hermione', data: { label: '朋友' } },
    { source: 'snape', target: 'voldemort', data: { label: '暗中效忠' } },
    { source: 'dumbledore', target: 'snape', data: { label: '信任' } },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const wrapper = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! as HTMLElement : container;
  wrapper.style.position = 'relative';

  // Use the same fit for initial render, resize, and the toolbar action.
  // A low maxZoom leaves this small network tiny on large or high-DPI canvases.
  const fitOptions = { padding: 64 };
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: fitOptions,
    container: wrapper,
    data,
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: {
        fill: (n) => COLORS[n.data?.house as string] ?? '#5B8FF9',
        stroke: '#fff',
        strokeWidth: 2,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#bbb',
        lineWidth: 1.5,
        endArrow: true,
      },
    },
    layout: {
      type: 'd3-force',
      linkDistance: 180,
      nodeStrength: -600,
      collideRadius: 60,
      forceSimulation: null,
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node'],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();

  const g = graph as unknown as GraphInstanceWithTools;
  const cleanupNodeLabels = attachLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    nodeLabel: (n) => n.name ?? n.id,
    position: 'below',
    fontSize: 11,
    color: '#333',
  });
  const cleanupEdgeLabels = attachEdgeLabelsCanvas(wrapper, g, {
    fontSize: 9,
    color: '#555',
    rotated: true,
    showBg: false,
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(fitOptions),
    destroy: () => { cleanupNodeLabels(); cleanupEdgeLabels(); graph.destroy(); },
  };
}
```

# Search and focus (/en/docs/examples/search-focus)





Search nodes by name, highlight matches, and move the viewport to them.

## Try it

Type part of a name to highlight matches and bring them into view.

## Data

Twelve named nodes are matched by a name fragment.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: search nodes by name, highlight matches, and focus the viewport.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const PEOPLE = [
  'Alice',
  'Bob',
  'Carol',
  'David',
  'Emma',
  'Frank',
  'Grace',
  'Helen',
  'Ivan',
  'Julia',
  'Kevin',
  'Laura',
];

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  host.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: host,
    data: {
      nodes: PEOPLE.map((name, index) => ({
        id: name.toLowerCase(),
        data: { label: name, group: index % 3 },
      })),
      edges: PEOPLE.slice(1).map((name, index) => ({
        source: PEOPLE[index % 4].toLowerCase(),
        target: name.toLowerCase(),
      })),
    },
    node: {
      style: {
        size: 32,
        fill: (node) => ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16'][Number(node.data?.group ?? 0)],
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'bottom',
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 180 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();

  const hint = '输入名称片段，例如 al';
  const ui = createDemoPanel(host, hint);
  let highlighted: string[] = [];
  ui.gui.add({ query: '' }, 'query').name('搜索节点').onChange((value: string) => {
    for (const id of highlighted) graph.clearItemStates(id);
    const query = value.trim().toLowerCase();
    highlighted = query
      ? graph
          .getNodes()
          .filter((node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id).toLowerCase().includes(query))
          .map((node) => node.id)
      : [];
    for (const id of highlighted) graph.setItemState(id, 'highlight', true);
    if (highlighted.length > 0) graph.focusItem(highlighted, 48);
    ui.setStatus(query ? `${highlighted.length} 个匹配` : hint);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Viewport guide](/en/docs/guides/viewport)
- [Viewport methods](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-viewport)

# Click, brush, and lasso selection (/en/docs/examples/selection-behaviors)





Compare click, brush, and lasso selection behaviors in one example.

## Try it

All three work at once: Shift+click to multi-select, Shift+drag to brush, Ctrl/Cmd+drag to lasso.

## Data

Regularly distributed nodes make different selection ranges easy to compare.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const nodes = Array.from({ length: 12 }, (_, index) => ({
    id: String(index),
    x: 120 + (index % 4) * 120,
    y: 100 + Math.floor(index / 4) * 110,
  }));
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: { nodes, edges: [] },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 3 } },
    },
    behaviors: [
      { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
      'zoom-canvas',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' },
      { type: 'lasso-select', key: 'ctrl' },
    ],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container, 'Shift+点击多选，Shift+拖拽框选，Ctrl/⌘+自由拖拽套索选择。');

  // Keep the modifier keys visible at all times; the event line updates as
  // the user interacts, the hint line stays.
  const HINT = 'Shift+点击多选 · Shift+拖拽框选 · Ctrl/⌘+拖拽拉索';
  const render = (eventName: string) => {
    const selected = graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || '-';
    ui.setStatus(`${HINT}\n${eventName}\nselected=${selected}`);
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', () => render('node:selectchange'));
  graph.on('brush:end', () => render('brush:end'));
  graph.on('lasso:end', () => render('lasso:end'));
  render('ready');

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Using states](/en/docs/guides/states)
- [Combine interactions](/en/docs/guides/behaviors)

# Replace graph data (/en/docs/examples/set-data)





Replace the whole graph with setData, then switch layouts.

## Try it

Data A/B show 5/8 nodes. Then try layout, hiding, and focus. Replacement does not retain elements from the previous dataset.

## Data

The toolbar replaces the nodes and edges, then runs layout again.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: setData + layout() 端到端验证
 * 测试运行时整体数据替换和布局切换
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

const DATA_A = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'a1' },
    { id: 'a2' },
    { id: 'a3' },
    { id: 'a4' },
    { id: 'a5' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'a1', target: 'a2' },
    { source: 'a1', target: 'a3' },
    { source: 'a2', target: 'a4' },
    { source: 'a3', target: 'a5' },
    { source: 'a4', target: 'a5' },
  ],
};

const DATA_B = {
  nodes: [
    { id: 'b1' },
    { id: 'b2' },
    { id: 'b3' },
    { id: 'b4' },
    { id: 'b5' },
    { id: 'b6' },
    { id: 'b7' },
    { id: 'b8' },
  ],
  edges: [
    { source: 'b1', target: 'b2' },
    { source: 'b1', target: 'b3' },
    { source: 'b2', target: 'b4' },
    { source: 'b3', target: 'b5' },
    { source: 'b4', target: 'b6' },
    { source: 'b5', target: 'b7' },
    { source: 'b6', target: 'b8' },
    { source: 'b7', target: 'b8' },
  ],
};

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const el = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;

  el.style.position = 'relative';

  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: el,
    data: DATA_A,
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 120 },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      'drag-node',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      'highlight-node',
      'highlight-edge',
    ],
    node: { style: { size: 20, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph.render();

  const log = (msg: string) => console.log(`[setData demo] ${msg}`);

  graph.on('datachange', (e: any) => log(`datachange: ${e.nodeCount} nodes, ${e.edgeCount} edges`));
  graph.on('layout:start', () => log('layout:start'));
  graph.on('layout:end', (e: any) => log(`layout:end: ${e.duration.toFixed(1)}ms`));

  const ui = createDemoPanel(el);
  ui.addChoice('数据', { 'A · 5 节点': 'a', 'B · 8 节点': 'b' }, 'a', async (value) => {
    const next = value === 'b' ? DATA_B : DATA_A;
    log(`setData → DATA_${value.toUpperCase()}`);
    await graph.setData(next);
    graph.fitView();
    log(`done. nodeCount=${graph.getNodeCount()}`);
  });

  ui.addChoice('布局', ['circular', 'grid', 'force'], 'circular', async (value) => {
    log(`setLayout(${value}) + layout()`);
    if (value === 'grid') graph.setLayout({ type: 'grid' });
    else if (value === 'force') graph.setLayout({ type: 'd3-force' });
    else graph.setLayout({ type: 'circular', radius: 150 });
    await graph.layout();
    graph.fitView();
    log(`${value} done`);
  });

  const updateVisibility = (action: 'hide' | 'show') => {
    const id = graph.hasNode('b1') ? 'b1' : 'a1';
    log(`${action}Item(${id})`);
    if (action === 'hide') graph.hideItem(id);
    else graph.showItem(id);
    log(`states after ${action}: ${JSON.stringify(graph.getItemStates(id))}`);
  };
  ui.addAction('hideItem', () => updateVisibility('hide'));
  ui.addAction('showItem', () => updateVisibility('show'));
  ui.addAction('focusItem', () => {
    const id = graph.hasNode('b8') ? 'b8' : 'a5';
    log(`focusItem(${id})`);
    graph.focusItem(id);
  });

  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView(),
    destroy() {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```

- [setData contract](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-data-mutations-setdata)
- [View preservation](/en/docs/guides/viewport)

# Node shapes (/en/docs/examples/shapes)





Compare circle and rectangle nodes side by side.

## Try it

Compare circle and rectangle nodes in the two graphs.

## Data

Two small graphs use circle and rectangle nodes.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: 混合图形 — 矩形节点 + 弧线边 + 粗线边
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // --- Rect nodes with arc edges ---
  const rectContainer = document.createElement('div');
  rectContainer.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  rectContainer.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;';
  const arcLabel = document.createElement('div');
  arcLabel.textContent = 'Rect nodes + Arc edges';
  arcLabel.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:4px;left:8px;color:#888;font-size:12px;z-index:1;';
  rectContainer.appendChild(arcLabel);
  (typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! : container).appendChild(rectContainer);

  const graph1 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: rectContainer,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: '0', name: 'A' },
        { id: '1', name: 'B' },
        { id: '2', name: 'C' },
        { id: '3', name: 'D' },
        { id: '4', name: 'E' },
        { id: '5', name: 'F' },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: '0', target: '1' },
        { source: '0', target: '2' },
        { source: '1', target: '3' },
        { source: '2', target: '4' },
        { source: '3', target: '5' },
        { source: '4', target: '5' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: (d) => ['#5B8FF9', '#5AD8A6', '#F6BD16', '#E86452', '#6DC8EC', '#945FB9'][parseInt(d.id) % 6],
        width: 32,
        height: 20,
      },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'arc',
      style: {
        stroke: '#aaa',
        curvature: 0.25,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 48 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node', 'highlight-edge'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph1.render();

  // --- Circle nodes with thick edges ---
  const thickContainer = document.createElement('div');
  thickContainer.className = 'demo-canvas-card';
  thickContainer.style.cssText = 'width:100%;height:45%;position:relative;margin-top:10px;';
  const thickLabel = document.createElement('div');
  thickLabel.textContent = 'Circle nodes + Thick edges (lineWidth: 3)';
  thickLabel.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;top:4px;left:8px;color:#888;font-size:12px;z-index:1;';
  thickContainer.appendChild(thickLabel);
  (typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector(container)! : container).appendChild(thickContainer);

  const graph2 = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container: thickContainer,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a' }, { id: 'b' }, { id: 'c' }, { id: 'd' }, { id: 'e' },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'd', target: 'e' },
        { source: 'e', target: 'a' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: { fill: '#E86452', size: 24 },
    },
    edge: {
      type: 'line',
      style: {
        stroke: '#6DC8EC',
        lineWidth: 3,
      },
    },
    layout: { type: 'circular', radius: 48 },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'highlight-node', 'highlight-edge'],
    theme: 'light',
  });
  await graph2.render();

  return {
    getData: () => ({ views: [graph1.getData(), graph2.getData()] }),
    fitView() {
      graph1.fitView();
      graph2.fitView();
    },
    destroy() {
      graph1.destroy();
      graph2.destroy();
      rectContainer.remove();
      thickContainer.remove();
    },
  };
}
```

# Tooltip (/en/docs/examples/tooltip)





Show custom business information while hovering nodes or edges.

## Try it

Hover nodes for roles and edges for relationship details.

## Data

Five collaborators and five business relationships.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
/**
 * Demo: Tooltip 浮层提示
 *
 * - 节点 hover:显示 label + 角色
 * - 边 hover:显示「源 → 目标(关系)」
 * - tooltip 开箱即用,命中事件由交互调度层统一分发,不依赖其它 behavior
 */
import { Graph, type TooltipContext } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'alice', data: { label: 'Alice', role: '产品经理' } },
        { id: 'bob', data: { label: 'Bob', role: '前端工程师' } },
        { id: 'carol', data: { label: 'Carol', role: '后端工程师' } },
        { id: 'dave', data: { label: 'Dave', role: '设计师' } },
        { id: 'erin', data: { label: 'Erin', role: '测试' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'alice', target: 'bob', data: { rel: '协作' } },
        { source: 'alice', target: 'carol', data: { rel: '协作' } },
        { source: 'bob', target: 'carol', data: { rel: '联调' } },
        { source: 'alice', target: 'dave', data: { rel: '评审' } },
        { source: 'bob', target: 'erin', data: { rel: '提测' } },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'circle',
      style: { fill: '#5B8FF9', size: 18, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id) },
    },
    edge: { type: 'line', style: { stroke: '#C0C0C0', lineWidth: 2 } },
    layout: { type: 'force', maxIteration: 300 },
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      'highlight-node',
      'highlight-edge',
      {
        type: 'tooltip',
        trigger: 'hover',
        getContent: (ctx: TooltipContext) => {
          if (ctx.itemType === 'node') {
            const { label, role } = (ctx.data ?? {}) as { label?: string; role?: string };
            return `<div style="font-weight:600">${label ?? ctx.nodeId}</div>
                    <div style="color:#8c8c8c;font-size:12px">${role ?? ''}</div>`;
          }
          const rel = (ctx.data as { rel?: string })?.rel ?? '关联';
          return `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}<br/><span style="color:#8c8c8c">${rel}</span>`;
        },
      },
    ],
    theme: 'light',
  });

  await graph.render();
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => graph.destroy(),
  };
}
```

- [Using Tooltip](/en/docs/guides/behaviors#tooltip)
- [Behavior reference](/en/docs/api/options#options-behaviors)

# Viewport and coordinate conversion (/en/docs/examples/viewport-controls)





Validate camera, fit, zoom, focus, resize, and screen/graph coordinate conversion.

## Try it

Run viewport operations from the toolbar and inspect coordinates and dimensions.

## Data

Fixed-position nodes make viewport and coordinate APIs observable.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 60, y: 80, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 420, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 240, y: 300, data: { label: 'C' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'ab', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'bc', source: 'b', target: 'c' },
        { id: 'ca', source: 'c', target: 'a' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 36, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
  });
  await graph.render();
  graph.fitView({ padding: 80 });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  const showCamera = (prefix: string) => {
    const camera = graph.getCamera();
    ui.setStatus(`${prefix}\nzoom=${camera.zoom.toFixed(3)} x=${camera.x.toFixed(1)} y=${camera.y.toFixed(1)}\nnodes=${graph.getNodes().length} edges=${graph.getEdges().length}`);
  };

  const addCameraAction = (label: string, action: string, run: () => void) => {
    ui.addAction(label, () => {
      run();
      showCamera(action);
    });
  };
  addCameraAction('zoomBy +', 'zoom-in', () => graph.zoomBy(1.25));
  addCameraAction('zoomBy −', 'zoom-out', () => graph.zoomBy(0.8));
  addCameraAction('fitView', 'fit', () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }));
  addCameraAction('fitCenter', 'center', () => graph.fitCenter());
  addCameraAction('focus C', 'focus', () => graph.focusItem('c'));
  addCameraAction('setCamera', 'camera', () => graph.setCamera({ zoom: 1.1, x: 80, y: 40 }));
  addCameraAction('resetCamera', 'reset', () => graph.resetCamera());
  addCameraAction('setSize', 'resize', () => graph.setSize(720, 460));
  ui.addAction('坐标互转', () => {
    const position = graph.getNodePosition('a')!;
    const screen = graph.graphToScreen(position.x, position.y);
    const restored = graph.screenToGraph(screen.x, screen.y);
    ui.setStatus(`graph=(${position.x.toFixed(1)}, ${position.y.toFixed(1)})\nscreen=(${screen.x.toFixed(1)}, ${screen.y.toFixed(1)})\nrestored=(${restored.x.toFixed(1)}, ${restored.y.toFixed(1)})`);
  });

  showCamera('ready');
  return {
    getData: () => graph.getData(),
    fitView: () => graph.fitView({ padding: 64 }),
    destroy: () => {
      graph.destroy();
      ui.destroy();
    },
  };
}
```
