- [Viewport methods](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-viewport)

# Zoom range and sensitivity (/en/docs/examples/zoom-options)





Limit wheel zoom with sensitivity, minimum zoom, and maximum zoom.

## Try it

Zoom with the wheel, or jump to the minimum, 1x, and maximum zoom.

## Data

Wheel zoom is limited to the range 0.4–2.

## Complete runnable code

```ts
// Local presentation helpers in this repository are used only for the example controls.
/**
 * Demo: constrain wheel zoom with sensitivity, minZoom, and maxZoom.
 */
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import { createDemoPanel } from './demo-panel.ts';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // #region navigation
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
    { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  ] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
  // #endregion navigation
  const [{ minZoom, maxZoom }] = behaviors;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 180, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 120 },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 250 },
        { id: 'd', x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    behaviors,
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const report = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Zoom ${graph.getZoom().toFixed(2)}× · ${minZoom}–${maxZoom}×`);
  };
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  let reportFrame: number | undefined;
  const onWheel = () => {
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    reportFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { reportFrame = undefined; report(); });
  };
  host.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });

  const fitView = graph.fitView.bind(graph);
  graph.fitView = (options) => { fitView(options); report(); };
  const zoomTo = graph.zoomTo.bind(graph);
  graph.zoomTo = (zoom, options) => { zoomTo(zoom, options); report(); };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    host.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction(`${minZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(minZoom));
    ui.addAction('1×', () => graph.zoomTo(1));
    ui.addAction(`${maxZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(maxZoom));
    report();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```


## Related documentation

- [Viewport guide](/en/docs/guides/viewport)
- [Viewport methods](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-viewport)

# Performance comparison (/en/docs/metrics/performance)



This comparison covers G6Lite, G6, Sigma.js, and the ECharts Graph series. All renderers receive the same precomputed positions, and all bundles use the same build settings. The 2026-11-13 run used a locally packaged G6Lite `0.1.0` build.

<span id="library-selection-comparison" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="selecting-a-graph-library" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="current-public-measurement-scope" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

## First-draw timing [#render-time]

The table shows the median time in milliseconds from graph creation through two animation frames after the render API completes. Headless Chromium uses the SwiftShader software renderer for WebGL in this run.

| npm package                         | Renderer  | 1,000 nodes / 3,000 edges (ms) | 5,000 nodes / 15,000 edges (ms) |
| ----------------------------------- | --------- | -----------------------------: | ------------------------------: |
| `@antv/g6-lite@0.1.0`               | WebGL     |                          134.1 |                           146.1 |
| `@antv/g6@5.1.1`                    | Canvas 2D |                          297.4 |                         1,502.2 |
| `sigma@4.0.4` + `graphology@0.26.0` | WebGL 2   |                          466.1 |                           748.4 |
| `echarts@6.1.0`                     | Canvas 2D |                           56.6 |                           236.3 |

<span id="environment-requirements" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="how-to-compare-numbers" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

<span id="rules-for-numerical-comparisons" style="{ display: 'block', scrollMarginTop: '8rem' }" />

### Test conditions [#benchmark-method]

* Apple M3 Pro, macOS (Darwin 25.2.0), headless Chromium 151.0.7922.34. The canvas is 900 × 600 CSS pixels at DPR 1. The WebGL renderer reports `ANGLE (Google, Vulkan 1.3.0 (SwiftShader Device (LLVM 10.0.0) (0x0000C0DE)), SwiftShader driver)`.
* Each library receives the same nodes, edges, and fixed positions. The graphs use circular nodes and straight edges, with labels and animation disabled and no layout run. For each size, each library warms up 3 times, then runs 20 interleaved samples. The instance is disposed after each sample.
* Libraries are loaded before timing. Samples cover instance and internal model creation, the first render, and two animation frame callbacks. Sigma.js includes building the Graphology graph. Measure GPU execution, layout, and interactions separately. [Download raw samples](/benchmarks/graph-performance.json)

These results apply only to the environment above and do not certify minimum supported browser versions. See [Minimum browser versions](/en/docs/compatibility/browser#minimum-browser-versions) for capability version references and the remaining acceptance scope.

## Browser bundle size [#bundle-size]

esbuild 0.21.5 bundles each npm entry and its dependencies into a single minified browser script. The G6Lite measurement uses the default entry, with optional layouts imported separately as needed. ECharts imports GraphChart and CanvasRenderer only. Sigma.js includes Graphology. Sizes are in KiB and exclude source maps.

| npm package                         | Minified (KiB) | gzip -9 (KiB) |
| ----------------------------------- | -------------: | ------------: |
| `@antv/g6-lite@0.1.0`               |          511.3 |         159.5 |
| `@antv/g6@5.1.1`                    |        1,435.3 |         413.4 |
| `sigma@4.0.4` + `graphology@0.26.0` |          438.4 |         110.7 |
| `echarts@6.1.0`                     |          386.3 |         130.2 |

### G6Lite CDN file sizes [#umd-size]

Each CDN file is measured with `gzip -9`. One kB is 1,000 bytes. The homepage shows the size of the default script.

| Published file           | Contents                                                          | gzip -9 (kB) |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | -----------: |
| `g6-lite.min.js`         | Default script with rendering, interactions, and built-in layouts |        150.2 |
| `g6-lite-layouts.min.js` | Six optional layouts, loaded when needed                          |         29.1 |

Load the optional script before registering the layout you want to use. [Optional layouts](/en/docs/guides/layout-overview#optional-layouts)

## Measuring your own graph [#performance-tuning]

Use production data and target devices to measure layout, first draw, and interactions separately. For a slow startup, isolate layout from drawing before assessing Worker execution. For slow updates, reuse the graph and update data or states incrementally. For frame drops during zoom, compare labels, decorations, and viewport size one at a time. Check disposal and listener cleanup after repeated mounts. [Worker layouts](/en/docs/guides/layout-worker) · [Data mutations](/en/docs/api/graph#graph-data-mutations) · [Label policy](/en/docs/api/options#options-label)

**Related runnable examples**

* [200 nodes](/en/docs/examples/large)
* [5000 nodes with labels](/en/docs/examples/large-labeled)
* [AI Papers large relationship graph](/en/docs/examples/real-dataset)


# Brush select (/en/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select)





Drag a rectangle to select nodes whose centers fall inside it.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Set the activation key with `key`. In the example, hold Shift and drag from empty space to select, or drag without a modifier to pan.

## Example [#example]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['drag-canvas', { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' }];
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorOption } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-config
  const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['drag-canvas', { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' }];
  // #endregion behavior-config

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[Options and defaults](/en/docs/api/options#selection)


# Click to select (/en/docs/guides/behavior-click-select)





Click a node or edge to toggle selection. Click empty canvas to clear it.

## Configuration [#configuration]

With `multiple` enabled, hold the key named by `trigger` while clicking to add to the selection.

## Example [#example]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = [{ type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' }];
```

```ts
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },

        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
```

# Drag canvas (/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-canvas)





Drag empty space to pan the graph.

## Configuration [#configuration]

With `ignoreModifierKeys: true`, holding Shift, Ctrl, or Meta leaves the drag gesture available for brush or lasso selection.

## Example [#example]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = [{ type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true }];
```

```ts
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },

    throw error;
```

# Drag edge endpoints (/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge)





Drag an endpoint of an existing edge and use the drop event to read the proposed connection.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Start dragging near an endpoint. On release, `edge:dragend` reports the proposed connection. Call `updateEdgeData()` to apply it.

## Example [#example]



```ts
graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
  if (reconnected && edgeId) {
    graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
  }
  ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
});
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 240, data: { label: 'C' } },
        { id: 'd', x: 560, y: 160, data: { label: 'D' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'editable-edge', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'reference-edge', source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 38, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { lineWidth: 4, hitAreaWidth: 16, endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-edge'],
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  graph.on('edge:dragstart', (payload: { edgeId?: string; dragEnd: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`dragstart ${payload.edgeId ?? '-'} (${payload.dragEnd})`);
  });
  // #region reconnect
  graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
    if (reconnected && edgeId) {
      graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
    }
    ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
  });
  // #endregion reconnect

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



[Options and defaults](/en/docs/api/options#navigation-and-dragging)


# Drag nodes and combos (/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node)





Drag a node, or drag empty space within a combo to move the entire combo.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Dragging a selected node moves the other selected nodes with it. Change combo membership through the combo API.

## Example [#example]



```ts
behaviors: [
  'zoom-canvas',
  'drag-canvas',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  'drag-node',
],
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: drag individual nodes, and drag a combo by its background.
 */
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'web', data: { label: 'Web' }, x: 160, y: 150, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'app', data: { label: 'App' }, x: 160, y: 250, comboId: 'clients' },
        { id: 'api', data: { label: 'API' }, x: 380, y: 200 },
        { id: 'db', data: { label: 'DB' }, x: 560, y: 140 },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: 'Cache' }, x: 560, y: 270 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'app', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'db' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'cache' },
      ],
      combos: [{ id: 'clients', data: { label: '客户端' } }],
    },
    node: {
      type: 'rect',
      style: {
        fill: '#5B8FF9',
        width: 72,
        height: 32,
        borderRadius: 8,
        label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id),
        labelPlacement: 'center',
        labelColor: '#fff',
      },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2' } },
    },
    combo: {
      style: {
        label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.label ?? combo.id),
        labelPlacement: 'top',
      },
    },
    edge: { style: { endArrow: true, stroke: '#99ADD1' } },
    // #region drag-options
    behaviors: [
      'zoom-canvas',
      'drag-canvas',
      { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
      'drag-node',
    ],
    // #endregion drag-options
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.fitView({ padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 });
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[Options and defaults](/en/docs/api/options#navigation-and-dragging) · [Change combo membership](/en/docs/guides/combo#change-membership)


# Drag nodes, combos, and edges (/en/docs/guides/behavior-dragging)





[Drag nodes and combos](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node) · [Drag edge endpoints](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge)

## Drag nodes and combos [#drag-nodes-and-combos]

Enable `drag-node` to move nodes. Dragging a selected node moves the other selected nodes with it. Dragging empty space inside a combo moves the whole combo.



```ts
behaviors: [
  'zoom-canvas',
  'drag-canvas',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  'drag-node',
],
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts

        { id: 'db', data: { label: 'DB' }, x: 560, y: 140 },
        { id: 'cache', data: { label: 'Cache' }, x: 560, y: 270 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'web', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'app', target: 'api' },
        { source: 'api', target: 'db' },

      type: 'rect',

      style: {
        label: (combo) => String(combo.data?.label ?? combo.id),
```

Use the combo API to change membership. [Combo methods](/en/docs/guides/combo#change-membership)

## Drag an edge endpoint [#drag-an-edge-endpoint]

Enable `drag-edge` to drag an endpoint. On release, `edge:dragend` reports the proposed endpoints. Use `updateEdgeData()` to save an accepted reconnection.



```ts
graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
  if (reconnected && edgeId) {
    graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
  }
  ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
});
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 120, y: 160, data: { label: 'A' } },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 80, data: { label: 'B' } },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 240, data: { label: 'C' } },
        { id: 'd', x: 560, y: 160, data: { label: 'D' } },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'editable-edge', source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { id: 'reference-edge', source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 38, label: (node) => String(node.data?.label ?? node.id), labelPlacement: 'center', labelColor: '#fff' } },
    edge: { style: { lineWidth: 4, hitAreaWidth: 16, endArrow: true } },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', 'drag-edge'],
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);

  graph.on('edge:dragstart', (payload: { edgeId?: string; dragEnd: string }) => {
    ui.setStatus(`dragstart ${payload.edgeId ?? '-'} (${payload.dragEnd})`);
  });
  // #region reconnect
  graph.on('edge:dragend', ({ edgeId, source, target, reconnected }) => {
    if (reconnected && edgeId) {
      graph.updateEdgeData([{ id: edgeId, source, target }]);
    }
    ui.setStatus(`dragend reconnected=${reconnected}\n${edgeId ?? '-'}: ${source} → ${target}`);
  });
  // #endregion reconnect

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;

      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```




# Highlight on edge hover (/en/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-edge)





Hover an edge to emphasize it and its two endpoints.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Moving the pointer away restores the original appearance. Use neighborhood highlighting to handle both node and edge hover.

## Example [#example]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-edge'];
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorOption } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-config
  const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-edge'];
  // #endregion behavior-config

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[Try combined node and edge highlighting](/en/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight#example) · [Highlighting rules](/en/docs/api/options#highlighting)


# Highlight on node hover (/en/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-node)





Hover a node to emphasize it, its immediate neighbors, and their connecting edges.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Moving the pointer away restores the original appearance. Use neighborhood highlighting to style the highlighted state.

## Example [#example]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-node'];
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorOption } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-config
  const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['highlight-node'];
  // #endregion behavior-config

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[Try combined node and edge highlighting](/en/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight#example) · [Highlighting rules](/en/docs/api/options#highlighting)


# Highlight neighbors (/en/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight)





Highlight a node’s neighborhood or an edge and its endpoints on hover.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Set the neighborhood depth with `degree` and dim other elements with `inactiveState`. Hover B to see its one-hop neighborhood.

```ts
behaviors: [{ type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
```

## Example [#example]



```ts
behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 120, y: 0 },
        { id: 'C', x: 240, y: 0 }, { id: 'D', x: 360, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 120, y: 100 }, { id: 'Isolated', x: 360, y: 100 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { source: 'B', target: 'C' },
        { source: 'C', target: 'D' }, { source: 'B', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { highlight: { fill: '#00A876', stroke: '#005C41', strokeWidth: 2 } },
    },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 }, stateStyles: { highlight: { stroke: '#00A876', lineWidth: 2 } } },
    // #region highlight
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
    // #endregion highlight
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `highlight: ${graph.findNodesByState('highlight').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.on('node:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('node:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[Run the example and view the full code](/en/docs/examples/neighbor-highlight) · [Options and defaults](/en/docs/api/options#highlighting)


# Lasso select (/en/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select)





Trace a freehand outline to select nodes whose centers fall inside it.

## Configuration [#configuration]

With `key: 'ctrl'`, hold Ctrl or Command and drag from empty space to circle nodes.

## Example [#example]



```ts
const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['drag-canvas', { type: 'lasso-select', key: 'ctrl' }];
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorOption } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-config
  const behaviors: BehaviorOption[] = ['drag-canvas', { type: 'lasso-select', key: 'ctrl' }];
  // #endregion behavior-config

  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 120, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 120, y: 65 },
        { id: 'D', x: 240, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' },
        { id: 'A-C', source: 'A', target: 'C' },
        { id: 'B-D', source: 'B', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'C-D', source: 'C', target: 'D' },
        { id: 'D-E', source: 'D', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    edge: {
      style: { lineWidth: 2, hitAreaWidth: 14, endArrow: false },
      stateStyles: { selected: { stroke: '#8050d2', lineWidth: 4 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 48, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```

# Zoom and pan the canvas (/en/docs/guides/behavior-navigation)





[Drag canvas](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-canvas) · [Zoom canvas](/en/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas)

## Configuration [#configuration]

Enable `zoom-canvas` for wheel zoom and `drag-canvas` to pan by dragging empty space. Omitting `behaviors` enables both.

Set wheel speed with `sensitivity` and its limits with `minZoom` and `maxZoom`. Set `ignoreModifierKeys` to `true` to reserve modified drags for brush or lasso selection.

## Example [#example]

Use the wheel over the canvas and watch the current zoom in the bottom-left corner. Drag empty space with the left mouse button to pan.



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
  { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: constrain wheel zoom with sensitivity, minZoom, and maxZoom.
 */
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // #region navigation
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
    { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  ] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
  // #endregion navigation
  const [{ minZoom, maxZoom }] = behaviors;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 180, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 120 },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 250 },
        { id: 'd', x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    behaviors,
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const report = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Zoom ${graph.getZoom().toFixed(2)}× · ${minZoom}–${maxZoom}×`);
  };
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  let reportFrame: number | undefined;
  const onWheel = () => {
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    reportFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { reportFrame = undefined; report(); });
  };
  host.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });

  const fitView = graph.fitView.bind(graph);
  graph.fitView = (options) => { fitView(options); report(); };
  const zoomTo = graph.zoomTo.bind(graph);
  graph.zoomTo = (zoom, options) => { zoomTo(zoom, options); report(); };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    host.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction(`${minZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(minZoom));
    ui.addAction('1×', () => graph.zoomTo(1));
    ui.addAction(`${maxZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(maxZoom));
    report();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



Wheel zoom stays between 0.4× and 2×. Calls to `zoomTo()` and `fitView()` use their own options. [Navigation and dragging options](/en/docs/api/options#navigation-and-dragging)


# Interaction overview (/en/docs/guides/behavior-overview)





## What is a behavior? [#what-is-a-behavior]

A behavior defines how the graph responds to user input. For example, drag empty space to pan, use the wheel to zoom, or click a node to select it.

## Built-in behaviors [#built-in-behaviors]

Add built-in behaviors directly to `behaviors`. Open a behavior to see its options and example.

| Category    | Behavior                                                           | Type              | Description                                                                                  |
| ----------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------ | ----------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Navigation  | [Drag canvas](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-canvas)                | `drag-canvas`     | Drag empty space to pan the graph.                                                           |
| Navigation  | [Zoom canvas](/en/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas)                | `zoom-canvas`     | Use the mouse wheel to zoom around the canvas center.                                        |
| Selection   | [Click to select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-click-select)           | `click-select`    | Click a node or edge to toggle selection. Click empty canvas to clear it.                    |
| Selection   | [Brush select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select)              | `brush-select`    | Drag a rectangle to select nodes whose centers fall inside it.                               |
| Selection   | [Lasso select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select)              | `lasso-select`    | Trace a freehand outline to select nodes whose centers fall inside it.                       |
| Editing     | [Drag nodes and combos](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-node)        | `drag-node`       | Drag a node, or drag empty space within a combo to move the entire combo.                    |
| Editing     | [Drag edge endpoints](/en/docs/guides/behavior-drag-edge)          | `drag-edge`       | Drag an endpoint of an existing edge and use the drop event to read the proposed connection. |
| Exploration | [Highlight on node hover](/en/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-node) | `highlight-node`  | Hover a node to emphasize it, its immediate neighbors, and their connecting edges.           |
| Exploration | [Highlight on edge hover](/en/docs/guides/behavior-highlight-edge) | `highlight-edge`  | Hover an edge to emphasize it and its two endpoints.                                         |
| Exploration | [Highlight neighbors](/en/docs/guides/behavior-hover-highlight)    | `hover-highlight` | Highlight a node’s neighborhood or an edge and its endpoints on hover.                       |
| Exploration | [Tooltip](/en/docs/guides/behavior-tooltip)                        | `tooltip`         | Show details for a node or edge on hover or click.                                           |

## Custom behaviors [#custom-behaviors]

Wrap reusable event handlers in a custom behavior, then register it and enable it by name. [See custom behaviors](/en/docs/guides/custom-behavior)

## Configuration and usage [#configuration-and-usage]

### Basic configuration [#basic-configuration]

Pass a `behaviors` array to `new Graph()`. A name uses the default settings. Omitting `behaviors` enables wheel zoom and canvas panning.

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const graph = new Graph({
  container,
  data,
  behaviors: ['drag-canvas', 'zoom-canvas', 'click-select'],
});

await graph.render();
```

### Configure behavior options [#configure-behavior-options]

Set the behavior name in `type` and put its options alongside it. In the example, click to select, Shift-click to add, or drag from empty space to select a rectangle.



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
  'drag-node',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorName, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-options
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
    'drag-node',
    { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
    { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
  ] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
  // #endregion behavior-options
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H'].map((id, i) => ({
        id, x: (i % 4) * 120, y: Math.floor(i / 4) * 100,
      })),
      edges: [{ id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { id: 'D-H', source: 'D', target: 'H' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 2, haloWidth: 12 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `selected nodes: ${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', updateStatus);
  graph.on('selection:clear', updateStatus);
  graph.on('brush:end', updateStatus);
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### Update behaviors at runtime [#update-behaviors-at-runtime]

Use `setBehaviors()` to replace the full list at runtime. Include every behavior you want to enable.

```ts
graph.setBehaviors(['drag-canvas', { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 0.5 }]);
```

[Try switching behaviors](/en/docs/guides/behaviors#switch-behaviors)

### Remove behaviors [#remove-behaviors]

Pass an empty array to disable all behaviors. Omit the argument to restore default panning and zooming.

```ts
graph.setBehaviors([]);
```

## Behaviors and events [#behaviors-and-events]

Use `graph.on()` to listen for `node:click` when a click should update your application UI. Unsubscribe with the same handler on unmount.

```ts
const onNodeClick = ({ nodeId }: { nodeId: string }) => console.log(nodeId);
graph.on('node:click', onNodeClick);

// On component unmount
graph.off('node:click', onNodeClick);
```

[Common behavior options](/en/docs/guides/behaviors) · [Event guide](/en/docs/guides/events)


# Click, brush, and lasso selection (/en/docs/guides/behavior-selection)



[Click to select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-click-select) · [Brush select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-brush-select) · [Lasso select](/en/docs/guides/behavior-lasso-select)



## Choose a selection gesture [#choose-a-selection-gesture]

| Gesture                              | Configuration                                                                        |
| ------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Click a node or edge                 | `click-select`. Enable `multiple` and hold the `trigger` key to add to the selection |
| Draw a rectangle around nodes        | `brush-select`, with `key` setting the modifier                                      |
| Draw a freehand outline around nodes | `lasso-select`, with `key` setting the modifier                                      |

## Configuration and example [#configuration-and-example]

Click to select, Shift-click to add to the selection, or drag from empty space to select a rectangle. Set selected node colors in `node.stateStyles.selected`.



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
  'drag-node',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BehaviorName, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region behavior-options
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', minZoom: 0.5, maxZoom: 2 },
    'drag-node',
    { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
    { type: 'brush-select', key: null },
  ] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
  // #endregion behavior-options
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E', 'F', 'G', 'H'].map((id, i) => ({
        id, x: (i % 4) * 120, y: Math.floor(i / 4) * 100,
      })),
      edges: [{ id: 'A-B', source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { id: 'D-H', source: 'D', target: 'H' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#873BF4', stroke: '#5B21B6', strokeWidth: 2, haloWidth: 12 } },
    },
    behaviors,
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `selected nodes: ${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', updateStatus);
  graph.on('selection:clear', updateStatus);
  graph.on('brush:end', updateStatus);
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



When enabling pan, brush, and lasso together, give them distinct gestures. Try the [selection example](/en/docs/examples/selection-behaviors). To update an application panel after selection, listen for [selection events](/en/docs/guides/events/selection-drag).


# Tooltip (/en/docs/guides/behavior-tooltip)





Show details for a node or edge on hover or click.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Set the trigger with `trigger` and return the content from `getContent`. In click mode, click the same element again or click empty canvas to close the tooltip.

```ts
behaviors: [{ type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120 }],
```

## Example [#example]



```ts
const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
  type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
  enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
  getContent: (ctx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
    const detail = document.createElement('div');
    detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
      ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
      : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
    card.append(title, detail);
    return card;
  },
};
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region tooltip
  const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
    type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
    enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
    getContent: (ctx) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
      const detail = document.createElement('div');
      detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
        ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
        : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
      card.append(title, detail);
      return card;
    },
  };
  // #endregion tooltip
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'API', x: 0, y: 0, data: { label: '<API Gateway>', requests: 1280 } },
        { id: 'DB', x: 180, y: 0, data: { label: 'Database', requests: 960 } },
        { id: 'Cache', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'request', source: 'API', target: 'DB', data: { label: 'Request' } },
        { id: 'warm', source: 'DB', target: 'Cache', data: { label: 'Warm cache' } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 } },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 } },
    behaviors: [tooltip],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



[Run the example and view the full code](/en/docs/examples/tooltip) · [Options and defaults](/en/docs/api/options#tooltipoptions) · [See click triggering and styling](/en/docs/guides/behaviors#tooltip)


# Zoom canvas (/en/docs/guides/behavior-zoom-canvas)





Use the mouse wheel to zoom around the canvas center.

## Configuration [#configuration]

Set wheel sensitivity with `sensitivity` and the wheel zoom range with `minZoom` and `maxZoom`.

## Example [#example]



```ts
const behaviors = [
  { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
  { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
/**
 * Demo: constrain wheel zoom with sensitivity, minZoom, and maxZoom.
 */
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: string | HTMLElement) {
  // #region navigation
  const behaviors = [
    { type: 'zoom-canvas', sensitivity: 1.4, minZoom: 0.4, maxZoom: 2 },
    { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  ] satisfies [BuiltInBehaviorConfig, BuiltInBehaviorConfig];
  // #endregion navigation
  const [{ minZoom, maxZoom }] = behaviors;
  const graph = new Graph({
    autoFit: true,
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'a', x: 180, y: 180 },
        { id: 'b', x: 340, y: 120 },
        { id: 'c', x: 340, y: 250 },
        { id: 'd', x: 500, y: 180 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'a', target: 'b' },
        { source: 'a', target: 'c' },
        { source: 'b', target: 'd' },
        { source: 'c', target: 'd' },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 28, fill: '#5B8FF9' } },
    behaviors,
  });
  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const report = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Zoom ${graph.getZoom().toFixed(2)}× · ${minZoom}–${maxZoom}×`);
  };
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  let reportFrame: number | undefined;
  const onWheel = () => {
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    reportFrame = requestAnimationFrame(() => { reportFrame = undefined; report(); });
  };
  host.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: true });

  const fitView = graph.fitView.bind(graph);
  graph.fitView = (options) => { fitView(options); report(); };
  const zoomTo = graph.zoomTo.bind(graph);
  graph.zoomTo = (zoom, options) => { zoomTo(zoom, options); report(); };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    host.removeEventListener('wheel', onWheel);
    if (reportFrame !== undefined) cancelAnimationFrame(reportFrame);
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    ui.addAction(`${minZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(minZoom));
    ui.addAction('1×', () => graph.zoomTo(1));
    ui.addAction(`${maxZoom}×`, () => graph.zoomTo(maxZoom));
    report();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



[Options and defaults](/en/docs/api/options#navigation-and-dragging)


# Common behavior options (/en/docs/guides/behaviors)





List behaviors in `new Graph()` through `behaviors`. See the [Interaction overview](/en/docs/guides/behavior-overview) for the available behaviors.

## BehaviorOption [#built-in-behaviors]

Use a behavior name, such as `'drag-canvas'`, to use its defaults. To customize it, pass an object with its name in `type` and its options alongside it.

See the [11 built-in behavior previews](/en/docs/api/options#built-in-index).

## Configure pan, brush, and lasso [#common-combinations]

Drag empty space to pan, Shift-drag to select a rectangle, or Ctrl/Meta-drag to select a freehand area.

```ts
import type { BehaviorName, BuiltInBehaviorConfig } from '@antv/g6-lite';

const behaviors = [
  'zoom-canvas',
  { type: 'drag-canvas', ignoreModifierKeys: true },
  'drag-node',
  { type: 'click-select', multiple: true, trigger: 'shift' },
  { type: 'brush-select', key: 'shift' },
  { type: 'lasso-select', key: 'ctrl' },
] satisfies Array<BehaviorName | BuiltInBehaviorConfig>;
```

Try the three gestures in the [selection example](/en/docs/examples/selection-behaviors). Click selection distinguishes `ctrl` and `meta`, while area selection accepts either when set to `ctrl`. See the [selection reference](/en/docs/api/options#selection) for details.

## Switch behaviors at runtime [#switch-behaviors]

Choose Browse to pan by dragging empty space. In Select mode, drag empty space to brush or click a node to select it. The selection and view stay in place when you switch back to Browse or choose Off.



```ts
if (mode === 'select') {
  graph.updateOptions({ behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'click-select', 'brush-select'] });
} else if (mode === 'browse') {
  graph.setBehaviors(['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas']);
} else {
  graph.setBehaviors([]);
}
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';
import GUI from 'lil-gui';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 },
        { id: 'B', x: 150, y: -65 },
        { id: 'C', x: 150, y: 65 },
      ],
      edges: [{ source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { source: 'A', target: 'C' }],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 28, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { selected: { fill: '#8050d2', haloWidth: 10 } },
    },
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas'],
    autoFit: { padding: 55, maxZoom: 1 },
  });

  const ui = createDemoPanel(container);
  const switchMode = (mode: string) => {
    // #region switch
    if (mode === 'select') {
      graph.updateOptions({ behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'click-select', 'brush-select'] });
    } else if (mode === 'browse') {
      graph.setBehaviors(['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas']);
    } else {
      graph.setBehaviors([]);
    }
    // #endregion switch
  };
  const showSelection = () => {
    ui.setStatus(`Selected: ${graph.findNodesByState('selected').join(', ') || 'none'}`);
  };
  graph.on('node:selectchange', showSelection);
  graph.on('selection:clear', showSelection);
  graph.on('brush:end', showSelection);

  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => {
    ui.destroy();
    destroy();
  };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    showSelection();
    ui.addChoice('Mode', { Browse: 'browse', Select: 'select', Off: 'off' }, 'browse', switchMode);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}


export function createDemoPanel(container: string | HTMLElement, description = '') {
  const host = typeof container === 'string' ? document.querySelector<HTMLElement>(container)! : container;
  if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';

  let gui: GUI | undefined;
  const getGui = () => {
    if (!gui) {
      gui = new GUI({ container: host, width: 160 });
      gui.domElement.classList.add('g6lite-demo-controls');
      gui.domElement.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      Object.assign(gui.domElement.style, {
        position: 'absolute',
        top: '10px',
        right: '10px',
        zIndex: '30',
        maxWidth: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
        maxHeight: 'calc(100% - 20px)',
      });
    }
    return gui;
  };

  let status: HTMLDivElement | undefined;
  const setStatus = (message: string) => {
    if (!status) {
      status = document.createElement('div');
      status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
      status.dataset.role = 'status';
      status.dataset.captureIgnore = '';
      status.style.cssText =
        'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:10px;z-index:20;max-width:min(28rem,calc(100% - 24px));color:#64748b;font:12px/1.45 system-ui,sans-serif;pointer-events:none;white-space:pre-wrap;';
      host.append(status);
    }
    status.textContent = message;
  };
  if (description) setStatus(description);

  return {
    get gui() {
      return getGui();
    },
    addAction(label: string, action: () => void, folder = getGui()) {
      return folder.add({ [label]: action }, label);
    },
    addChoice<T extends string>(
      label: string,
      choices: readonly T[] | Record<string, T>,
      value: T,
      onChange: (value: T) => void,
    ) {
      const options = Array.isArray(choices) ? [...choices] : choices;
      return getGui().add({ value }, 'value', options).name(label).onChange(onChange);
    },
    setStatus,
    destroy() {
      gui?.destroy();
      status?.remove();
    },
  };
}
```



Pass the complete list. `setBehaviors([])` disables all behaviors, and `setBehaviors()` restores default zoom and pan. See [`setBehaviors()`](/en/docs/api/graph#setbehaviors) for the full rules.

## Zoom feel and bounds [#zoom-feel-and-bounds]

Set sensitivity, minZoom, and maxZoom on zoom-canvas; sensitivity: 0.5 softens wheel response. Zoom centers on the canvas. Wheel bounds do not restrict programmatic fitView. See [navigation options](/en/docs/api/options#navigation-and-dragging) for defaults, normalization, and fallback.

## Neighborhood highlighting [#neighborhood-highlighting]

Hover B to highlight A/B/C/E and connecting edges while dimming other nodes. An edge emphasizes itself and its endpoints. Leaving clears hover states. State styles define green; the Behavior decides when to apply the states.



```ts
behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'A', x: 0, y: 0 }, { id: 'B', x: 120, y: 0 },
        { id: 'C', x: 240, y: 0 }, { id: 'D', x: 360, y: 0 },
        { id: 'E', x: 120, y: 100 }, { id: 'Isolated', x: 360, y: 100 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { source: 'A', target: 'B' }, { source: 'B', target: 'C' },
        { source: 'C', target: 'D' }, { source: 'B', target: 'E' },
      ],
    },
    node: {
      style: { size: 30, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 },
      stateStyles: { highlight: { fill: '#00A876', stroke: '#005C41', strokeWidth: 2 } },
    },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 }, stateStyles: { highlight: { stroke: '#00A876', lineWidth: 2 } } },
    // #region highlight
    behaviors: ['zoom-canvas', 'drag-canvas', { type: 'hover-highlight', degree: 1, inactiveState: 'inactive' }],
    // #endregion highlight
    autoFit: { padding: 60, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  const status = document.createElement('div');
  status.style.cssText = 'position:absolute;left:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:20;background:white;color:#334155;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:6px;font:12px system-ui;';
  status.setAttribute('role', 'status');
  const updateStatus = () => {
    status.textContent = `highlight: ${graph.findNodesByState('highlight').join(', ') || 'none'}`;
  };
  const destroy = graph.destroy.bind(graph);
  graph.destroy = () => { status.remove(); destroy(); };
  try {
    await graph.render();
    graph.on('node:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('node:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerover', updateStatus);
    graph.on('edge:pointerleave', updateStatus);
    updateStatus();
    container.append(status);
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



## Tooltip [#tooltip]

Enable `tooltip` in `behaviors` to show node and edge details. Use hover for previews or click for details that stay open.

### Custom content [#custom-content]

Hover API, DB, or an edge for 120ms to show a card; leave to hide it. enable excludes the Cache node. The code returns an HTMLElement populated with textContent, so angle brackets in the API name remain literal text.



```ts
const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
  type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
  enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
  getContent: (ctx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
    const detail = document.createElement('div');
    detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
      ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
      : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
    card.append(title, detail);
    return card;
  },
};
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region tooltip
  const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
    type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'hover', delay: 120, className: 'docs-hover-tooltip',
    enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
    getContent: (ctx) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
      const detail = document.createElement('div');
      detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
        ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
        : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
      card.append(title, detail);
      return card;
    },
  };
  // #endregion tooltip
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'API', x: 0, y: 0, data: { label: '<API Gateway>', requests: 1280 } },
        { id: 'DB', x: 180, y: 0, data: { label: 'Database', requests: 960 } },
        { id: 'Cache', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'request', source: 'API', target: 'DB', data: { label: 'Request' } },
        { id: 'warm', source: 'DB', target: 'Cache', data: { label: 'Warm cache' } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 } },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 } },
    behaviors: [tooltip],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### Click to show [#click-to-show]

Click API, DB, or an edge to show details. Repeating the same element or clicking empty canvas closes the card. Click mode does not use the hover delay; the displayed code runs this exact configuration.



```ts
const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
  type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'click', className: 'docs-click-tooltip',
  enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
  getContent: (ctx) => {
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
    const title = document.createElement('strong');
    title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
    const detail = document.createElement('div');
    detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
      ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
      : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
    card.append(title, detail);
    return card;
  },
};
```

**Complete runnable code**

```ts
import { Graph, type BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap } from '@antv/g6-lite';

export async function run(container: HTMLElement) {
  // #region tooltip
  const tooltip: BuiltInBehaviorOptionsMap['tooltip'] = {
    type: 'tooltip', trigger: 'click', className: 'docs-click-tooltip',
    enable: (ctx) => ctx.nodeId !== 'Cache',
    getContent: (ctx) => {
      const card = document.createElement('div');
      card.style.cssText = 'padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#163B65;color:white;font:12px system-ui;box-shadow:0 4px 16px #163b6533;';
      const title = document.createElement('strong');
      title.textContent = String(ctx.data?.label ?? ctx.nodeId ?? ctx.edgeId ?? '');
      const detail = document.createElement('div');
      detail.textContent = ctx.itemType === 'node'
        ? `Requests: ${Number(ctx.data?.requests ?? 0)}`
        : `${ctx.source} → ${ctx.target}`;
      card.append(title, detail);
      return card;
    },
  };
  // #endregion tooltip
  const graph = new Graph({
    container,
    data: {
      nodes: [
        { id: 'API', x: 0, y: 0, data: { label: '<API Gateway>', requests: 1280 } },
        { id: 'DB', x: 180, y: 0, data: { label: 'Database', requests: 960 } },
        { id: 'Cache', x: 360, y: 0 },
      ],
      edges: [
        { id: 'request', source: 'API', target: 'DB', data: { label: 'Request' } },
        { id: 'warm', source: 'DB', target: 'Cache', data: { label: 'Warm cache' } },
      ],
    },
    node: { style: { size: 32, label: (node) => node.id, labelOffsetY: 8 } },
    edge: { style: { hitAreaWidth: 12 } },
    behaviors: [tooltip],
    autoFit: { padding: 56, maxZoom: 1 },
  });
  try {
    await graph.render();
    return graph;
  } catch (error) {
    graph.destroy();
    throw error;
  }
}
```



### Options [#options]

Find defaults, callback signatures, container, and context fields in [TooltipOptions](/en/docs/api/options#tooltipoptions) and [TooltipContext](/en/docs/api/options#tooltipcontext). ctx.event is the original mouse event, unlike the nativeEvent property on ordinary Graph events.

Default content uses node data.label/id, or edge data.label/endpoint names. Custom getContent strings are written as HTML, so escape dynamic values. When HTML is unnecessary, prefer an element filled through textContent as above.

### Styling [#styling]

The library positions and shows/hides the surface without a visual skin. Both examples style the returned element directly. Alternatively, configure className and style the outer surface, such as its default class:

```css
.g6lite-tooltip {
  padding: 8px 12px;
  border-radius: 8px;
  background: #163b65;
  color: white;
  font-size: 12px;
}
```

By default the surface mounts in document.body, uses viewport positioning, and flips at edges. A custom container changes both mounting and collision boundaries; verify positioning ancestors, scrolling, and clipping, including how transforms affect fixed positioning.

### Tooltip questions [#tooltip-questions]

#### Why is the card unstyled or unclickable? [#why-is-the-card-unstyled-or-unclickable]

Provide application CSS; there is no built-in visual skin. The overlay has pointer-events: none. Use your own application overlay for buttons, forms, or interactive cards.

#### Why does a Combo show no Tooltip? [#why-does-a-combo-show-no-tooltip]

The built-in handles nodes/edges only. Use public events with an application overlay for Combo details rather than internal picking.

#### Does an open card update immediately after data changes? [#does-an-open-card-update-immediately-after-data-changes]

setData does not recreate Tooltip. Later pointer events read content again. Use setBehaviors to change Tooltip configuration. The old Tooltip releases its listeners, timers, and overlay.

## Event dispatch [#event-dispatch]

Listening to node:click does not require click-select; that Behavior adds selected-state toggling. Subscribe before render if needed, then unsubscribe with the same function:

```ts
const onNodeClick = ({ nodeId }: { nodeId: string }) => console.log(nodeId);
graph.on('node:click', onNodeClick);
// On component unmount:
graph.off('node:click', onNodeClick);
```

Selection integration should account for node:selectchange, edge:selectchange, brush:end, and lasso:end. Query state for the final set; not every selection source emits a per-node selectchange. See the [event guide](/en/docs/guides/events#selection-and-drag-events) for integration and cleanup, and the [event reference](/en/docs/api/graph/events#selection-events) for complete payloads.

**Connection editing and dispatch internals**

drag-edge proposes reconnection without changing source/target or drawing a temporary edge. Handle edge:dragend, validate reconnected, update application edge data, then apply it through public methods such as setData. A configured layout still runs during setData; fitView: false preserves only the camera.

Shared picking prioritizes node → edge → combo → canvas. Behaviors consume that event stream; do not access internal Picking, Renderer, or eventEmitter.

## Common questions [#common-questions]

### Why did adding tooltip disable zoom? [#why-did-adding-tooltip-disable-zoom]

The explicit list replaced defaults. Include zoom-canvas and drag-canvas too.

### Why does brushing also move the canvas? [#why-does-brushing-also-move-the-canvas]

Bind brushing to Shift and retain drag-canvas's ignoreModifierKeys: true. Give brush and lasso different gestures.

### Can updateOptions switch Behaviors? [#can-updateoptions-switch-behaviors]

Yes. Use `setBehaviors()` to switch interactions, or pass `behaviors` to `updateOptions()` when updating appearance at the same time.

* [Drag nodes and combos](/en/docs/examples/drag-node)
